jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Valeris is a fully integrated life sciences commercialization partner that provides comprehensive solutions that span the entire healthcare value chain. Formed by the merger of PharmaCord and Mercalis, Valeris™ revolutionizes the path from life sciences innovation to real-life impact to build a world in which every patient gets the care they need. Valeris works on behalf of life sciences companies to improve the patient experience so that patients can access and adhere to critical medications. Backed by proven industry expertise, a deep commitment to patient care, the latest technology, and exceptionally talented team members, Valeris provides the data and strategic insights, patient support services and healthcare provider engagement tools to help life sciences companies successfully commercialize new products. Valeris provides commercialization solutions to more than 500 life sciences customers and has provided access and affordability support to millions of patients. The company is headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina and Jeffersonville, Indiana. To learn more about Valeris, please visit www.valeris.com.

**Position Summary**

As a Senior Project Manager within the Enterprise PMO, you will lead high-priority strategic and enterprise initiatives that advance Valeris business objectives, operating model maturity, and scalable growth. You will provide end-to-end leadership across complex, cross-functional efforts, bringing structure to ambiguity and aligning executive sponsors, functional leaders, and delivery teams around clear outcomes, decisions, and accountability.

This highly visible role requires exceptional executive presence, sound judgment, and the ability to influence across functions without direct authority. The successful candidate will establish strong governance, manage interdependencies and organizational change, and translate strategy into executable plans that deliver measurable business value.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead complex, enterprise-wide strategic initiatives from initiation through implementation, adoption, and transition to sustained ownership.
* Partner with executive sponsors and functional leaders to define the business problem, strategic outcomes, scope, success measures, and decision rights for each initiative.
* Develop and execute integrated project plans that include workstreams, milestones, critical path dependencies, resource requirements, financial considerations, and change impacts.
* Establish and lead program governance, including executive steering committees, sponsor reviews, decision forums, workstream cadences, and escalation pathways.
* Create alignment across Operations, Technology, Finance, Commercial, Product, People, and other business functions to advance enterprise priorities.
* Drive accountability for deliverables, commitments, decisions, and interdependencies; surface obstacles early and maintain momentum across competing priorities.
* Proactively identify and manage risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, and organizational readiness requirements, with clear mitigation and recovery plans.
* Manage scope and change through disciplined assessment of impacts to strategic outcomes, timeline, investment, resources, operating model, and benefits realization.
* Prepare and deliver concise executive-level status reports, dashboards, recommendations, and decision materials that enable timely, informed action.
* Monitor initiative health, milestones, resource utilization, budget performance, key performance indicators, and expected business benefits; recommend corrective action as needed.
* Support enterprise portfolio planning and prioritization by providing transparent delivery data, capacity insights, sequencing recommendations, and tradeoff analysis.
* Lead stakeholder engagement and change-management activities that promote adoption, clarify impacts, and ensure accountable owners are prepared to sustain new capabilities or processes.
* Strengthen Enterprise PMO maturity by advancing governance standards, templates, methodologies, portfolio reporting, and delivery best practices.
* Coach project managers and workstream leaders on effective planning, risk management, executive communication, and delivery discipline.

**Required Qualifications**

  

* PMP certification required; certification must be current and maintained in accordance with PMI requirements.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
* 8+ years of progressive project or program management experience leading complex, cross-functional strategic or enterprise initiatives from initiation through closure.
* Demonstrated success partnering with senior executives and influencing stakeholders across multiple business functions.
* Proven ability to lead through ambiguity, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and bring structure to evolving priorities.
* Experience establishing project governance, executive reporting, and decision-making forums for high-visibility initiatives.
* Strong command of project management methodologies, including Waterfall, Agile, and Hybrid approaches.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives, complex dependencies, resource constraints, and competing enterprise priorities.  
  Strong business acumen with experience evaluating delivery tradeoffs, resource needs, financial impacts, and business benefits.
* Advanced experience with Microsoft Office Suite; experience with portfolio management, reporting, or collaboration tools preferred.
* Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and executive communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA or other advanced degree.
* PMI-ACP, PgMP, Lean, or Six Sigma certification.
* Experience supporting enterprise transformation, operating model design, technology-enabled change, M&A integration, or process optimization initiatives.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, HR Systems Transformation
jobs.description:
**Senior Program Manager, HR Systems Transformation**  
Contract: 6–12 months, extension possible | Remote with occasional travel | Senior, executive-facing

**Overview**  
A large global enterprise is transforming a core HR platform, and the change reaches nearly every part of the organization. The initiative is underway, carries significant investment, and is closely watched by the company's most senior leaders. We're looking for a senior program leader to take charge of it. You'll set direction, earn executive confidence, and hold a wide network of teams accountable as the work moves across connected systems.

**What You'll Lead**

* Take ownership of an HR systems transformation already in progress and set a clear path to completion
* Establish and run program governance: steering committee schedule, decision frameworks, and escalation paths
* Be the trusted voice to senior executives on status, risks, trade-offs, and the decisions you need from them
* Prepare short executive briefings that show what's working, what's at risk, and the recommended next step
* Drive accountability across teams you don't directly manage, and settle competing priorities
* Work across HR, payroll, IT, and business teams to support integrations with connected systems, keeping dependencies visible and on track
* Guide the program through a stage-gated, PMI-aligned lifecycle and its gate reviews
* Partner with HR business partners on change impact so stakeholders stay confident in the rollout
* Bring leadership and structure to the existing project team

**Required Qualifications**

* Senior program or project leadership on complex, enterprise-scale transformations
* Proven executive presence: you've briefed and influenced senior executives and kept their confidence under pressure
* Experience establishing governance and running steering committees
* Track record of driving accountability across functions through influence rather than authority
* Experience working across multiple teams to support system integrations and manage the dependencies between them
* Delivery experience in waterfall or stage-gated environments
* Ability to travel occasionally

**Nice-to-Have Qualifications**

* HR system implementation experience (PeopleSoft preferred; Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or Oracle HCM also valued)
* Experience with HR, payroll, training, or onboarding integrations
* HR data migration or reclassification experience
* Organizational change management experience
* Exposure to Agile delivery

**Tools & Environment**  
PeopleSoft HCM and the systems connected to it. Stage-gated, PMI-aligned lifecycle, with onboarding on the client's methodology. Remote collaboration across a large, matrixed organization.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**  
You lead from the front. You walk into a large, complex organization, learn it fast, and become the person executives turn to for a straight answer. You're comfortable telling senior leaders what they need to hear, laying out hard trade-offs, and asking for decisions. You build trust across teams without formal authority and keep everyone focused on the same outcome. You see this as a business transformation, not a technical rollout. Strong performance may lead to an extension or follow-on work.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Program Manager**

**About Crowned Grace International**

Crowned Grace International (CGINTL) is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned and Woman-Owned Small Business that delivers management consulting, workforce transformation, and mission support to the Department of Defense, federal civilian agencies, and Fortune 1000 clients. CGINTL holds GSA Multiple Award Schedule and OASIS+ contracts, is ISO 9001:2015 certified, and maintains internal controls rated Adequate by DCAA. Our purpose is captured in our motto: Accelerating Mission-Ready Capabilities.

**The Opportunity**

CGINTL is building a team to help a federal civilian agency's Office of Acquisitions close a backlog of expired contracts, including cost-reimbursement contracts, IDIQs, and fixed-price and time-and-materials awards. You will lead the program end to end: setting the closeout plan and burn-down targets with the Contracting Officers, building and managing the team, removing blockers, and making sure every package that reaches the Government is complete, compliant, and ready for signature.

**What You'll Do**

* **Program leadership and Government liaison:** Acts as the primary point of contact for the COR and Contracting Officers. Leads kickoff, weekly status meetings, and monthly program reviews; documents Government direction and decisions.
* **Closeout planning and burn-down management:** Develops and maintains the integrated closeout plan. Works with the COs to prioritize actions by age, contract type, dollar value, and risk; sets burn-down targets and forecasts completion.
* **Staffing and personnel management:** Recruits, onboards, and assigns staff; manages badging and PIV processing; evaluates performance; directs any teammate; adjusts staffing as backlog volumes and CO priorities change.
* **Risk, issue, and escalation management:** Identifies blockers such as missing contractor releases, unsettled indirect rates, unreconciled unliquidated obligations, and non-responsive contractors; escalates each with a recommended course of action.
* **Quality and compliance oversight:** Owns the Quality Control Plan; enforces the inherently governmental boundary, safeguarding of contractor proprietary and personal information, personal conflict-of-interest requirements, and limitations on subcontracting.
* **Contract administration and reporting:** Delivers monthly status reports and contract deliverables, reviews invoices, and manages transition-in and transition-out.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business, public administration, or a related discipline.
* 10 years of directly related experience, including 5 years managing federal acquisition, contract administration, or acquisition-support programs.
* Project Management Professional (PMP). (required)
* Thorough knowledge of FAR Parts 4 and 42 closeout requirements and the roles of the CO, COR, and contractor
* Ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams to measurable production targets
* Skill in briefing senior Government officials and resolving issues across organizational lines
* Proficiency with project scheduling, metrics, and status reporting tools
* Ability to obtain and maintain a federal background investigation and PIV credential

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree
* FAC-C (Professional) or DoD Contracting Professional certification
* Prior management of a contract closeout or acquisition operations support program

**Work Environment**

Virtual position. May require travel to outreach events and occasional work outside normal hours.

**Our Culture**

At CGINTL, everyone is a Leader. We hire to, develop toward, and hold one another accountable to seven Core Values: IntegrityTrust; Credibility; Accountability ("No Excuses Here"); Continuous Improvement; Action Orientation; Caring for the Team, the Client, and the Business; and Marketplace Ministry.

jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Timmons Group** is hiring a **Senior Project Manager** to join our **Geospatial Solutions Development division**, based in **Richmond, VA or working remotely**. This position leads delivery for a long-standing state government client, a multi-year program with new development, enhancements, maintenance and support, and modernization all running at once. The position may also lead or support engagements for our other state, local, federal, and non-government clients.

The **Senior Project Manager** is the primary client contact, advising on how to sequence and fund competing priorities, planning across overlapping timelines, and working with cross-functional teams to execute. The role also owns the financial side, including budgets, change orders, and monthly invoicing, and calls for enough technical depth to plan around architecture, integrations, data migrations, and releases. We welcome candidates from consulting firms and from state or local government who have managed technology projects and vendor partnerships.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** include but are not limited to:

* Serve as the primary point of contact for the client, from day-to-day coordination through executive status reviews
* Advise the client on trade-offs and priorities across new development, enhancements, support, and modernization
* Navigate difficult conversations early, including scope disputes, slipping dates, and funding constraints
* Run an integrated plan across concurrent workstreams and sequence shared people and environments
* Hold teams to commitments; unblock, escalate, and keep work moving
* Fit the delivery approach (agile, predictive, or hybrid) to each workstream
* Manage risks, issues, dependencies, and decisions
* Partner with business analysts, engineers, QA, UX, and architects to build the backlog and release plan
* Balance support and maintenance requests against planned project work, including SLA commitments
* Coordinate releases, client UAT, and go-live readiness
* Own budgets, burn, and forecasts for each contract and task order
* Prepare monthly invoices and resolve billing questions with the client
* Price and negotiate change orders and new statements of work
* Lead or support additional client engagements as assigned

**Skills/Requirements** of a successful candidate include but are not limited to:

* Bachelor's degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* 7+ years managing custom software delivery, including 5+ years on state government programs, from either the vendor or agency side; experience with GIS or location-based applications is a plus
* Experience with natural resources or environmental agencies, or with local, federal, or private-sector clients, is desirable
* Experience as the main link between an agency and its technology partners on multi-year programs
* Experience running concurrent workstreams, including legacy modernization alongside ongoing support and enhancements, and sequencing shared people across them
* Hands-on contract and financial management, including budgets, invoicing, change orders, and public-sector procurement
* Fluency in agile, predictive, and hybrid delivery; PMP or agile certifications are desirable
* Strong advisory and communication skills, with the tenacity to keep work moving through difficult situations
* Comfort using AI tools in day-to-day work
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Microsoft 365, Basecamp, and Smartsheet, or comparable tools

**Compensation:** Our best estimate of the salary range for this position is $90,000-$140,000. There may be flexibility on salary for experienced candidates. Offers are based on a range of job-related factors such as internal equity, experience, skills, education, credentials, role complexity, and location. Information on our comprehensive benefits package can be found here.

 **Additional Information**

The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skills and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

We are looking for high energy, creative, flexible, patient, self-starters who are willing to work at a dynamic pace. Candidates must share a commitment to our company’s Vision, Mission and Shared Values.

**Timmons Group is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status.**

**Timmons Group** is a multi-disciplined firm recognized nationally as a “Best Firm to Work For”. We help government and private clients alike to scale and grow through GIS services. With over 30 years providing expert GIS services, our award-winning team is ready to provide the flexible services to meet the needs of any organization. Our service expertise ranges from traditional GIS architecture and system configuration to custom application development to Enterprise Asset Management. We pride ourselves in being technology professionals that differentiate our services with unrivaled customer service. We are dedicated to solving challenges and helping our clients achieve their vision. For more information, visit www.timmonsgis.com.

Eaton’s IS VEH VGNA division is currently seeking a Regional Program Manager Lead. This is a remote work opportunity that can be based from a home office and/or from an approved Eaton Mobility facility within the United States. Preference will be given to candidates residing within the Michigan/Indiana regional areas.  
  
The expected annual salary range for this role is $130000 - $190000 a year.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

The Regional Program Manager Lead is responsible for supervising and enabling a team of program managers in the successful delivery of complex, global New Product Introduction (NPI), Standard Transition Process (STP), and Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VA/VE) initiatives. This role will ensure consistent execution of enterprise program management methodologies (e.g., ProLaunch / ProPM) across programs by coaching, guiding, and monitoring program managers, driving governance, accountability, and performance discipline. We expect to complete this process by the end of the first half of 2027. The compensation and benefits that will initially be offered for this position are based on Eaton's plans, programs and practices. jobs.title: IT Service Delivery Program Manager, Healthcare
jobs.description:
Harbor IT is a leading Managed Service Provider (MSP) specializing in delivering cutting edge Cybersecurity, IT, and Cloud Services to a diverse portfolio of clients. We pride ourselves on our commitment to excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction. Harbor IT is backed by investment firm Worklyn Partners since 2022 and has built a national platform through acquisition and rapid organic growth. Our mission is to manage our clients’ technology and mitigate their cyber risks, so that they don’t have to.

**Position Overview:**

The Healthcare Practice Program Manager owns end-to-end operational performance of Harbor IT's Healthcare POD: the clients, the 9-person delivery team, the projects, and the service delivery workflows that hold it together. This role directly manages a Solution Architect, 3 Sr. Systems Engineers, 3 Technical Support Specialist IIs, 1 Technical Support Specialist, and 1 Project Manager. The POD-CIO and CSM sit inside the POD but report outside it into CX Leadership — the Program Manager is expected to operate in lockstep with both, especially on clinical escalations and EMR-related incidents, but does not manage them.

**Organizational Structure:**

Reports to the Healthcare Practice Director. The POD-CIO owns executive relationships, strategic IT roadmap, and expansion positioning. The CSM owns day-to-day client ops and satisfaction. This role owns POD delivery performance, SLA/KPI attainment, the delivery team, PMO and project outcomes, PSA data integrity, delivery margin inputs, and renewal execution.

**Key Responsibilities:**

• Directly manage the Solution Architect, Sr. Systems Engineers, Support Specialists, and Project Manager — hiring, coaching, performance management, and daily workload assignment.

* Own SLA/KPI attainment across the POD, with particular attention to EMR uptime, downtime escalation response times, and incident resolution for systems where delays directly affect patient care and clinical workflows.
* Serve as the senior escalation point for EMR-related incidents (e.g., Epic, Cerner, Meditech, athenahealth, NextGen, eClinicalWorks), coordinating with vendor support and clinical stakeholders under time pressure.
* Communicate directly and credibly with physicians, practice administrators, office managers, and clinical staff — translating technical issues into language a non-technical clinical audience can act on, and managing expectations during outages or go-lives.
* Own queue health, PSA hygiene, and financial inputs (utilization, time entry accuracy, agreement utilization) for the POD.
* Lead the POD's PMO function: EMR migrations, system upgrades, new clinic onboarding, and infrastructure projects, from scoping through closeout.
* Ensure delivery practices align with HIPAA/HITECH requirements and payer/compliance

obligations relevant to healthcare clients; partner with security/compliance functions on audits and risk findings.

* Join client SBRs and project reviews, packaging performance and clinical-impact narratives for practice leadership and executive sponsors.
* Own renewal execution for the POD book, working in lockstep with the POD-CIO.

**Qualifications & Skills:**

* Hands-on experience supporting EMR/EHR systems in a healthcare IT or MSP environment — administration, migrations, integrations, or escalation support (Epic, Cerner, Meditech, athenahealth, NextGen, eClinicalWorks, or comparable).
* Demonstrated ability to communicate with physicians and clinical stakeholders under pressure — explaining technical root cause and timelines without jargon, and holding composure when a system outage affects patient scheduling or care delivery.
* Proven people leadership managing technical/service delivery staff, including hiring and

performance accountability.

* Working knowledge of HIPAA, HITECH, and healthcare compliance requirements as they

intersect with IT service delivery.

* Hands-on PSA/ITSM platform experience (ConnectWise, Autotask, HaloPSA, ServiceNow, or comparable).
* ITIL-aligned service management knowledge; comfortable owning SLA targets and reporting against them, including a specific example of recovering from a miss.
* Strong executive presence, both client-facing (with doctors and practice administrators) and internal (with the delivery team).
* Financial literacy sufficient to own program budgets, utilization, and a renewal/expansion

number.

**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Healthcare Administration, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 6–8 years combining program/project management and service delivery management within an MSP, healthcare IT, or HIT environment, including at least 2 years as a formal manager of technical staff.
* Direct, hands-on EMR/EHR support or implementation experience required.
* PMP/CAPM and ITIL v4 Foundations a plus.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary commensurate with experience
* Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match
* Unlimited PTO and holidays
* Professional development opportunities

jobs.description:
The Program Manager (Launch)is responsible for leading the program workstreams that guide partner practices through Aledade's onboarding journey to achieve sustained success in value-based care. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role structures, executes, and monitors assigned launch initiatives, establishing clear milestones and task structures aligned with overall program objectives to maintain project timelines. By leveraging data-driven governance and program discipline, the Program Manager ensures full transparency into launch progress and identifies potential roadblocks early. Core responsibilities include designing workstream operational frameworks, defining and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs), proactively mitigating risks, and driving strategic alignment across Sales, Field, Implementation, and Product teams. The Program Manager facilitates cross-functional execution and directly oversees key launch deliverables to meet organizational goals. Combining strong organizational leadership with deep healthcare technology expertise, the ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments to advance Aledade's mission in value-based care.

### **Primary Duties**

* **Launch Program Management:** Plan and manage assigned launch workstreams from definition through close-out, including scope, milestones, dependencies, and owners. Build the program plan and task structure for each workstream, sequencing work by business priority, available resources, and dependencies. Maintain the workstream backlog and status in the team's tracking tools (e.g., Monday.com, Jira, Cloud Coach, Salesforce) so progress is visible without manual chasing. Identify and escalate risks and roadblocks early, with a proposed mitigation or options for the Sr. Director.

* **Goal Measurement & Analytics:** Define and monitor KPIs that show whether launch goals are being met, including follow-through and milestone completion rates. Analyze program and practice-level data (e.g., Tableau, Salesforce reporting) to surface opportunities, risks, and trends, and turn them into actionable recommendations. Prepare clear, decision-ready status updates and reporting for Implementation leadership and cross-functional partners. Account for data-capture limitations and changes over time when reading trends, so decisions are not driven by reporting artifacts.

* **Stakeholder Management**: Align Product, Implementation, Field, Sales, and Support on shared launch priorities and clear handoffs. Navigate competing priorities across internal teams and practice stakeholders while keeping launch objectives in focus. Articulate the business case and rationale ("why") behind launch initiatives to leadership, internal teams, and practice-facing audiences. Apply working knowledge of value-based care and ACO models to connect launch work to Aledade's broader business goals.

* **AI-Enabled Operations & Process Support:** Leverage automation and AI solutions to streamline reporting, minimize manual status tracking, and reduce operational overhead, sharing best practices across the team. Create and maintain standardized workstream templates, playbooks, and repeatable workflows to drive consistent program execution. Define operational guidelines and quality gates for AI-assisted workflows to ensure data accuracy, prevent tracking errors, and uphold long-term maintainability. Develop reusable prompt templates and workflow accelerators to empower the team and unlock capacity for high-impact program management. Proactively identify and propose process enhancements that drive operational efficiency.

* **Coaching & Thought Partnership:** Support Implementation team members on program-level challenges and help them connect their work to launch goals. Translate complex operational and program concepts into clear, accessible guidance. Contribute to cross-team initiatives, including interviewing and onboarding, as needed.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in a technical or relevant field. Significant relevant work experience may be accepted in lieu of educational requirements.
* 6+ years of relevant experience in healthcare (program management, project management, or a related field.).
* Demonstrated track record of managing multi-stakeholder programs or initiatives with competing priorities and tight timelines.
* Working knowledge of ambulatory EHR environments and how they affect clinical workflows and data exchange.
* Proficiency with program and project tracking tools (e.g., Monday.com, Jira, Salesforce, Tableau, or equivalent).
* Willingness and ability to travel 10–25% to partner practices, cross-functional meetings, and Aledade headquarters as needed.

### **Preferred KSA’s**

* PMP or equivalent program/project management certification.
* Change management certification or formal training (e.g., Prosci ADKAR).
* Agile/Scrum methodology and sprint-based delivery.
* AI-assisted program management tools, automated reporting, or API-based system integration.
* ACO or value-based care program experience, with understanding of Promoting Interoperability and quality measure reporting.
* Track record of influencing teams without direct authority.

* **Enterprise Project Lifecycle:** Deep understanding of the end-to-end implementation process for high-value enterprise accounts, specifically within a SaaS or professional services environment, ideally population health or value-based care tools.

jobs.title: Technical Deputy Program Manager
jobs.description:
### **Who We Are**

Lawelawe is a Native Hawaiian Owned Small Disadvantaged Business that provides professional and mission-support services to federal Government customers. We are committed to delivering dependable solutions, supporting our employees, and advancing our mission to uplift economically disadvantaged Native Hawaiian families and preserve Native Hawaiian heritage.

### **You Are**

An experienced technical leader who can manage software development, guide teams, and keep daily program operations moving forward. You bring sound judgment, strong communication skills, and the ability to translate complex requirements into clear priorities and achievable results. You are comfortable representing Lawelawe with Government customers, corporate leadership, and subcontractors while providing direction and accountability to assigned employees.

### **How You Will Make an Impact**

As the Technical Deputy Program Manager, serving as the Program Manager’s principal deputy and Lawelawe’s senior representative on the contract. Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That's why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 5M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

The TUNTAS Program Manager is the senior operational lead for the TUNTAS program. The role sets strategic direction, ensures technical quality, and makes sure program investments draw on Indonesia’s wider education system and donor landscape.
  
The role leads the design and delivery of an integrated package of technical assistance to district and provincial governments. The program aims to reduce school dropout and improve educational outcomes for vulnerable children and young people. It does this by strengthening access to inclusive, quality, and relevant learning through youth empowerment, school and community engagement, and sustainable education systems. It covers four districts in the two provinces with the highest concentration of dropout risk: Bogor and Depok (West Java), and Sidoarjo and Malang (East Java).
  
The role keeps the TUNTAS program design consistent and connected with other Save the Children initiatives in Indonesia, and aligned with the DBS Foundation, to maximize impact and support lasting system change. The position requires deep expertise in the Indonesian education system, both formal and non-formal. It also requires proven experience delivering large-scale capacity building at the local level and a strong grounding in adult learning and systems-strengthening approaches.
  
**KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY**
  
**Technical Leadership and Program Quality**

* Lead the overall implementation of the TUNTAS program across target locations, in line with the approved program design, donor commitments, national education priorities, and Save the Children’s policies and quality standards.
* Under the direction of the Head of Children Development, provide operational leadership, strategic implementation planning, and coordination across program components and locations.
* Work closely with the Education Technical Advisor and relevant technical specialists so that education interventions are technically sound, contextually appropriate, inclusive, and consistently implemented.
* Integrate life skills, dropout prevention, education continuity, and re-engagement pathways into one coherent program approach.
* Systematically integrate Gender Equality, Disability and Social Inclusion (GEDSI), climate change, child protection, and child participation into program design and implementation.
* Adjust work plans based on field data and monitoring results, resolve implementation issues quickly, and follow up on stakeholder feedback.

**Oversight and Management of Project Implementation**

* Coordinate the overall project, working closely with direct reports, local implementing partners, and stakeholders to deliver a high-quality program.
* Develop a Detailed Implementation Plan for all program areas. Ensure on-time delivery that meets the quality framework and standards, including monitoring and evaluation, and that program approaches work together.
* Ensure adherence to good programming guidelines, including international good practice.
* Raise any implementation issues with the line manager, with recommendations for resolution.
* Work with the Program Impact & Policy Department to maintain program quality framework standards and identify opportunities for scaling up work in project areas.
* Coordinate external technical assistance visits from Jakarta-based and international staff, as well as the donor.
* Ensure timely and accurate narrative and financial reporting to the National Office and Save the Children Members.
* Maintain a green rating on program KPIs, as reviewed monthly by Save the Children.

**Financial Management**

* Develop program budgets and projections with the program and Finance teams.
* Ensure effective and efficient use of project resources.
* Regularly monitor budget vs. actual expenditure and proactively propose changes to expenditure plans and projections.
* Apply appropriate controls to project resources, including accurate tracking of all expenditure and financial management and tracking for implementing partners.
* Coordinate with the Finance unit to produce accurate and timely financial reports.
* Review financial reports to confirm they match project activities.

**Partnership Management, Eco-Convener and Localization**

* Manage program implementation through local partners, applying the localization roadmap across its seven dimensions.
* Secure the resources needed for program success, in line with Save the Children and donor standards.
* Support the growth of SC Indonesia’s portfolio through staff capacity building, partnership and network development, and new funding opportunities. Provide evidence-based, strategic input to proposal development, drawing on learning and evaluation from ongoing projects and regular assessment and research with relevant departments.
* Provide input on Save the Children Indonesia’s strategic initiatives and innovations within its transformation journey, mainly eco-convener, localization, and integrated programming with regional development.
* Strengthen strategic partnerships with the Partnerships unit to increase the reach and impact of Save the Children Indonesia’s mission.
* Work closely with the Awards, PIC, Partnerships, Finance, Supply Chain, and field implementation teams on partner assessment, transparent selection, and capacity building, in line with SC Partnership Principles.
* Directly manage relationships with partners that implement in more than one Save the Children Indonesia area. Ensure good coordination between these partners and the area and field offices.
* Support the National Office in conducting partner capacity assessments and capacity-strengthening plans within the area of supervision.

jobs.title: Security Analyst
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

BCC Software develops innovative software and data solutions that power critical customer communications for organizations across North America. With more than 45 years of industry leadership, we combine deep postal expertise with modern technology to help our customers streamline operations, improve efficiency, and drive growth.

 **Job Description**

The Security Analyst supports BCC Software’s cybersecurity program by defining, validating, and reporting on security controls to protect company assets and sensitive information and reduce cyber risk. This role uses recognized frameworks, third-party audits, and defined service-level agreements to guide security governance, operations, and continuous improvement. IT owns day-to-day system administration.

Essential Functions

* Strengthen identity security using Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, phishing-resistant MFA, and Privileged Identity Management (PIM).
* Integrate, deploy, support, and continuously improve security tools and the Microsoft security stack, including Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel and KQL, and Microsoft Intune security capabilities.
* Oversee the managed detection and response (MDR) provider, including escalations, tuning, and service reviews.
* Own the vulnerability and exposure management program, establish remediation SLAs, verify remediation evidence, and report status, exceptions, and risk trends.
* Lead incident response and serve as the primary security contact during incidents; maintain playbooks, escalation procedures, tabletop exercises, and on-call expectations.
* Establish Azure cloud security guardrails for landing zones and oversee Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and related cloud security controls.
* Own data protection controls through Microsoft Purview sensitivity labeling and data loss prevention for customer data and personally identifiable information.
* Enforce the AI Usage Policy and govern risks associated with Microsoft Copilot oversharing, shadow AI, and SaaS discovery.
* Manage third-party and vendor security risk, including due diligence, recurring reviews, evidence collection, and customer security questionnaires.
* Manage security ticket workflows for access reviews and phishing reports; define response SLAs and verify supporting evidence.
* Create and maintain security documentation, including policies, the risk register, incident response records, and audit evidence.
* Align the security program with NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0, CIS Controls, SOC 2 Type II, USPS licensing security requirements, and cyber insurance attestations.
* Validate ransomware resilience through evidence of immutable backups and recurring recovery testing.
* Manage the security awareness training program and work across teams to reinforce security policies, controls, monitoring, and best practices.
* Provide backup support for network, server, and cloud administration as needed, without assuming primary responsibility for routine administration.
* Assist with security-related budgets and purchases.
* Serve as liaison with security and IT professionals at BlueCrest and Platinum.
* Develop and manage security reports and dashboards for management.

  
**Qualifications**  

* 5+ years of cybersecurity operations experience or equivalent experience.
* Strong understanding of secure network architecture and networking principles.
* Knowledge of Windows, macOS, and Linux operating systems.
* Hands-on security experience with Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Azure, including Entra ID, Conditional Access, phishing-resistant MFA, PIM, Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Intune security capabilities, Defender for Cloud, and Azure Policy.
* Ability to review the security configuration and risk posture of network infrastructure, including Juniper and Cisco switches and Fortinet firewalls.
* Experience supporting SOC 2 Type II audits, including control validation and evidence collection.
* Familiarity with NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0 and CIS Controls.
* PowerShell scripting and KQL query skills for security operations, investigation, and automation.
* Ability to respond quickly to critical problems and willingness to participate in an on-call rotation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to define security SLAs, evaluate evidence, report risk, and communicate requirements to technical and business stakeholders.
* Understanding of adversary tactics and tooling (MITRE ATTACK; e.g., Cobalt Strike and Mimikatz) sufficient to detect, hunt, and validate controls.
* One or more relevant security certifications are preferred, including Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200), Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500), Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300), or CISSP.

  
**Additional Information**

**Work Location**

This position may be based anywhere within the United States. Occasional travel is expected to data center facilities, customer locations, or BCC Software headquarters in Rochester, New York. Candidates who live within driving distance of the Rochester office are strongly preferred.  
  
**Physical Demands**

This is primarily an office-based role requiring extended periods of sitting and frequent use of hands for typing, writing, and operating standard office equipment. The position requires effective verbal and written communication. Occasional standing, walking, bending, reaching, or lifting of office supplies or small equipment up to 25 pounds may be required. Visual acuity sufficient for reading, computer work, and document review is necessary. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

**Position Type and Expected Hours of Work**

This is a full-time, exempt position. Standard hours are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time, with time zone flexibility for employe

**Who are we?**

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

**About the role**

Smarsh is looking for a Senior Marketing Analyst to build the data foundation that marketing and go-to-market (GTM) teams run on — and that our AI tools will increasingly depend on. AI assistants and agents can only answer revenue questions reliably when the data model beneath them is clean, governed, and well defined. This role owns that layer for marketing: from source-system connectors and Snowflake, through dbt models and a governed semantic layer, to the dashboards, analysis, and AI-driven insight that leadership uses to make decisions.

You'll set the measurement and data roadmap, not just execute against it. You'll partner with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Sales/Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and IT/Data Architecture, and you'll be a trusted analytical partner to marketing and GTM leadership on planning, pipeline, and growth strategy.

### **How will you contribute?**

**Strategy, reporting & stakeholder leadership**

* Partner with marketing and GTM leadership on annual planning, pipeline targets and coverage, growth strategy, and operating cadences, bringing the analysis that grounds those decisions.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Second Front Systems is looking for a sharp, detail-oriented, data-driven Revenue Operations Analyst to help keep our revenue engine accurate, visible and running smoothly.  
  
We're a defense-technology company where precision and compliance drive outcomes. In this role you'll be hands-on with the data, systems and processes behind how revenue flows through 2F, from first pipeline to booking, renewal and expansion, across our commercial, federal and international sales motions.  
  
Reporting to our Manager of Revenue Operations, and part of a team led by our Director of Revenue Operations, you'll support forecasting, pipeline reporting, deal desk, sales compensation and Salesforce data quality. The goal is clean data, reliable reporting and fast, accurate answers that help Sales, Finance and leadership make better decisions.  
  
This is a high-visibility role with real room to grow. Your work will power the forecast, dashboards and comp numbers that leadership and the board rely on, and you'll see firsthand how complex commercial and government deals come together. You'll get broad exposure across forecasting, deal desk, sales compensation and Salesforce, direct mentorship, and more ownership as the team scales.  
  
**Note:** Candidates must reside in one of our approved hiring hubs:  

* DC/Maryland/Virginia
* Raleigh/Durham/Chapel Hill, NC
* Denver/Colorado Springs, CO
* Dallas/Fort Worth, TX

  
This is a full-time position.

**What You'll Do**  

* Keep pipeline data clean and trustworthy. Catch missing fields, stale opportunities and stage errors in Salesforce across commercial, federal, and international business units.
* Build and maintain reporting. Create and own Salesforce reports and dashboards for pipeline, bookings, win rates, sales cycle length, renewals and retention, so Sales, Finance and leadership all work from the same numbers.
* Support the forecast cadence. Prepare weekly forecast and pipeline review materials, track changes week over week, and flag deals at risk of slipping or being lost.
* Turn data into insight. Answer ad hoc questions from Sales and leadership, dig into trends and anomalies, and turn findings into clear, concise recommendations.
* Support deal desk and quote-to-cash. Review quotes and deal structures in DealHub and Salesforce for pricing accuracy, approvals and contract terms, and help keep deals moving quickly.
* Conduct sales compensation. Support quota tracking, crediting and monthly commission calculations, reconcile payouts with Finance, and answer rep questions quickly and accurately.
* Improve processes and systems. Document RevOps processes and definitions, find manual work to automate, and help roll out Salesforce improvements with our Senior Salesforce Solutions Architect.
* Support planning and enablement. Help with territory, capacity and quota analysis during annual planning, and help train GTM teams on tools, fields and process changes.

  
**What You Bring**  

* 2–4 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, FP&A or a similar analytical role, ideally at a B2B software company.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including lookups, pivot tables and building clean, reusable models.
* Comfort working with Sales, Finance and Customer Success teams, and handling multiple requests with competing deadlines.
* Curiosity and a builder mindset: you ask why the numbers look the way they do, and you look for ways to make the process better.
* Hands-on Salesforce experience, including building reports and dashboards, working with opportunity data and understanding how objects and fields fit together.
* Comfort with ambiguity in a fast-growing company, and an appetite to learn and take on more ownership over time.

**Preferred**  

* Salesforce Administrator certification(s) (Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, Business Analyst, and/or Sales Cloud Consultant a plus).
* Experience with DealHub or another CPQ tool, and with quote-to-cash workflows.
* Exposure to sales compensation administration.
* Working knowledge of SQL or a BI tool such as Tableau, Looker or Power BI.
* Experience in GovTech, defense or public-sector software, including familiarity with federal contract vehicles and government fiscal cycles.

  
The base salary for this position will fall between $90,000 and $100,000. Your ultimate compensation will be determined by professional background, technical proficiency, seniority, and regional cost factors. Furthermore, this opportunity includes potential eligibility for equity awards and discretionary bonuses, rounding out a comprehensive total rewards offering.

**One last thing:**  
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.  
  
**Are you ready to join our team:**  
To apply, click the “Apply for This Job” button at the top or bottom of this page and complete the application form. This position will remain open until filled, and applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.  
  
**State notices:**

An employer who violates this law is guilty of a misdemeanor and subject to a fine not exceeding $100.

jobs.title: Sr Information Security Manager
jobs.description:
**Sr Information Security Manager**

**ABOUT MPG**

Market Performance Group (MPG) is a leading end-to-end, strategy & services omnichannel commerce agency focused on creating the best PATH FORWARD — from market strategy to in-market reality — for today’s fastest-growing consumer packaged goods (CPG) manufacturers. Over the years, we’ve built a strong reputation as a trusted partner and valuable resource to a broad range of companies, from Fortune 500 to Private Equity, in categories that include health & wellness, food & beverage, home and hardlines. We revel in the opportunity to guide our clients on their path forward, building and activating strategies that ensure success. Everything we do is driven by our unrelenting commitment to leverage our deep operational experience, unparalleled omnichannel expertise, and industry relationships to drive performance in today’s dynamic omnichannel marketplace.

At MPG, we value our people and their contributions; they are critical to building the MPG Brand. Our leadership team has significant experience driving topline revenue and bottom-line profit, having held senior operating roles at leading CPG manufacturers and retailers. Our highly regarded, seasoned team of 400+ strategy and commercialization professionals brings strong operational experience and a collaborative approach. All team members are singularly focused on providing clients with pragmatic, real-world market approaches, built on the strong consumer, category and marketplace insights needed to create sustainable, profitable brand growth.

  

**Position Overview**

We are looking for an Information Security Manager to own MPG's information security and privacy program end to end: policy, training, incident response, risk, ISO 27001 and SOC 2 compliance, and the day-to-day security posture of the systems that hold company and client data. This role reports to the VP, Information Technology, and serves as the primary point of contact for senior management, clients, and auditors on security and privacy matters.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can set the policy and run the program — assessing risk, responding to incidents, and building the kind of security and privacy awareness that has to exist across the company, not just inside IT.

This is a security-focused role, not a broader IT management role: infrastructure, applications, and day-to-day IT operations stay with the VP, Information Technology and the rest of the IT organization. You own the security and privacy program; you partner with IT to get it implemented.

  

**What You'll Do**

* **Security Program & Policy**
* Assess people, processes, and technology across MPG to identify risk and vulnerabilities, and evaluate the effectiveness of the security and privacy program against changing laws, regulations, and industry trends.
* Implement the policies that make up a comprehensive information security and privacy program: security solutions, security and privacy training, incident response, audits, business continuity and disaster recovery, risk management, and change control.
* Manage the security solutions that protect MPG's applications, infrastructure, and networks, and ensure corporate networks, computers, and storage devices are monitored closely enough to catch attacks and respond to alerts quickly.
* **Incident Response & Risk**
* Run the incident management program: classify and mitigate incidents by risk level, manage the response, fix root causes so incidents do not recur, document everything formally, and communicate to internal stakeholders, clients, and government or local officials as required.

jobs.title: Information Systems Security Manager
jobs.description:
### **About Us**

AGE Solutions is a premier technology and professional services company, providing in-depth consulting, advanced technology solutions, and essential services throughout the U.S. government, defense, and intelligence sectors. Prioritizing innovation and client-focused solutions, we assist major agencies in addressing intricate issues and ensuring a more secure future.

AGE Solutions is seeking an experienced **Information System Security Manager (ISSM)** to support a program with our DoD customer. The ISSM will provide cybersecurity leadership and oversight for assigned information systems, applications, networks, and mission environments. This role is responsible for supporting Risk Management Framework (RMF) implementation, system authorization activities, continuous monitoring, and compliance with Department of Defense (DoD) cybersecurity requirements.

The successful candidate will work closely with Government stakeholders, system owners, engineers, assessors, and Information System Security Officers (ISSOs) to evaluate cybersecurity risks, maintain authorization readiness, and support secure adoption of emerging technologies.

**Responsibilities Include:**

* Lead cybersecurity governance and risk management activities for assigned information systems, applications, networks, and mission environments.
* Oversee RMF implementation, system authorization activities, and ongoing cybersecurity compliance.
* Manage the development, maintenance, and review of authorization documentation, including System Security Plans (SSPs), Security Assessment Reports (SARs), Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), and supporting artifacts.
* Provide oversight of continuous monitoring (ConMon), vulnerability management, remediation activities, and security control assessments.
* Evaluate cybersecurity risks and recommend mitigation strategies, compensating controls, and corrective actions.
* Coordinate with ISSOs, system owners, engineers, assessors, Authorizing Officials, and Government stakeholders to support authorization and risk acceptance decisions.
* Ensure alignment with DoDI 8510.01, applicable NIST guidance, DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), and customer-directed cybersecurity requirements.
* Support cybersecurity inspections, audits, assessments, and authorization readiness reviews.
* Develop cybersecurity metrics, risk assessments, executive-level reports, and briefings.
* Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and oversight to ISSOs and supporting cybersecurity personnel.
* Assess security implications associated with emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), autonomous systems, cloud environments, and experimental capabilities.
* Recommend risk mitigations, compensating controls, and security safeguards for prototypes, pilot programs, and test environments that may not align with traditional authorization approaches.
* Develop and maintain authorization packages and supporting security documentation for emerging technologies, prototypes, and pilot initiatives.

**Required Skills, Qualifications, and Experience:**

* **Citizenship and Clearance:**
  + U.S. Citizenship is required.
  + Must have and maintain a minimum of an active DoD Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain a DoD Top Secret clearance. A current Top Secret clearance is preferred.
* **Education and Certifications:**
  + Bachelor's degree is required.
  + Must meet applicable qualification requirements and possess at least one current certification recognized for DoD 8140 Work Role 722 – Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM), Intermediate level, such as:
    - CISSP
    - CISM
    - CGRC/CAP
    - SecurityX/CASP+
    - Security+
    - CCSP
    - GSEC
* **Experience:**
  + 5–10 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, information assurance, RMF, risk management, or security compliance.
  + Experience supporting RMF implementation, system authorization activities, and cybersecurity governance.
  + Experience developing, reviewing, or managing authorization packages and supporting security documentation.
* **Skills and Knowledge:**
  + Strong understanding of cybersecurity risk assessment, vulnerability management, security controls, and remediation processes.
  + Knowledge of DoDI 8510.01, NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-37, applicable CNSSI requirements, and DISA STIGs.
  + Strong analytical, leadership, communication, and technical documentation skills.
  + Ability to coordinate with technical teams, Government stakeholders, and cybersecurity leadership.
  + Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic mission environment.
  + Ability to obtain and maintain required customer-specific access and credentials.
* **Location:**
  + Candidates must reside within commuting distance of Fort Meade, MD. This position follows a **hybrid** work schedule, requiring onsite presence at Fort Meade two days per week, with additional onsite support as mission requirements dictate.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Experience supporting DoD, DISA, or other federal Government cybersecurity environments.
* Experience supporting cybersecurity authorization activities for cloud platforms, emerging technologies, prototypes, or pilot programs.
* Experience providing technical oversight or mentorship to cybersecurity personnel.

**Work Environment and Physical Demand:**

* This position primarily supports operations at a Government customer site.
* Standard work schedule is Monday through Friday, with adjustments based on mission requirements.
* Personnel must comply with applicable Government facility access, security, and operational requirements.

The projected salary range for this position is $150,000+ annually. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including years of relevant experience, active security clearance

jobs.title: IT Configuration and Change Business Analyst
jobs.description:
* The Configuration Analyst & Change Coordinator is responsible for supporting the governance, quality, and operational execution of Configuration Management (CMDB) and Change Management processes.
* This role ensures the integrity, accuracy, and compliance of configuration data while coordinating and controlling the lifecycle of IT changes to minimize risk, disruption, and service impact.
* The position plays a critical control function within IT Operations and works closely with infrastructure, application, security, risk, and audit teams.

### **Key Tasks & Responsibilities**

* **Configuration Management Support:**

* Assist in documenting and maintaining configuration items (CIs) in the Configuration Management Database (CMDB).
* Work closely with Configuration Managers to ensure accurate records of hardware, software, and related components.
* Help baseline the current set of CIs and ensure they are properly documented and controlled.
* Track changes to configuration items, ensuring updates are accurately reflected in the CMDB.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to verify and validate CI information, maintaining data integrity.
* Assist Change Managers in assessing the impact of proposed changes on configuration items.
* Provide support in identifying related configuration items affected by change requests.
* Help ensure that changes are properly documented and recorded in the CMDB.
* Assist in verifying and auditing changes to configuration items to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* **Change Management Support:**

* Coordinate the lifecycle of Normal, Standard, and Emergency Changes
* Perform quality checks on change submissions (risk, impact, backout plan, testing evidence)
* Validate risk scoring accuracy based on defined methodology
* Validate completeness before TRB and CAB review
* Maintain the enterprise change calendar
* Identify scheduling conflicts and risk overlaps
* Prepare CAB materials and documentation
* Track Post-Implementation Reviews (PIRs)
* Monitor change success rate and documentation compliance
* Escalate high-risk or non-compliant changes to the Change Manager
* **Continuous Improvement:**

* Participate in continuous assessment of Configuration Management processes and practices.
* Identify areas for improvement and provide input to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of configuration management activities.
* Collaborate with team members to implement approved improvements and changes.
* Stay updated on industry best practices and trends in Configuration Management to contribute to process enhancement efforts.
* Identify opportunities and implement plans to incorporate AI tools and efficiencies.

### **Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (preferred).
* 2+ Years experience supporting configuration and change management environment, requirements gathering, and documentation.
* Experience with the ITIL processes: configuration, change, release, production migration.
* Knowledge of Change Management principles and practices.
* Knowledge of Configuration Management principles and practices.
* Familiarity with Configuration and Change Management tools and databases, such as ServiceNow.
* Knowledge of IT infrastructure and support.
* Experience developing, writing and implementing SOPs.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* Strong experience with Microsoft M365 Suite, PowerBI.
* Hands-on experience with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, BMC, Jira Service Management)
* Eagerness to learn and adapt to evolving technologies and processes.
* Excellent coordination and follow-up skills
* Ability to challenge and enforce governance standards diplomatically
* Strong stakeholder communication skills

### **Certifications**

* ITIL Foundation v4 Certification (required)

### **Security Clearance**

* Public Trust Moderate (Tier 2)

### **Other (Travel, Work Environment, DoD 8570 Requirements, Administrative Notes, etc.)**

* May require sitting/standing for extended periods and performing tasks involving bending, stooping, and reaching.
* May require lifting and carrying heavy equipment.

$80,000 - $105,000 a year

The offered rate will be based on the selected candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities and/or experience and in consideration of internal parity. The posted range is appropriate for a typical candidate meeting, at a minimum, all the core requirements of the position.

jobs.title: Power Apps Business Analyst Lead
jobs.description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Analysis & Requirements Management**

* Engage with government stakeholders, program managers, and end users to understand business processes, operational challenges, reporting requirements, and desired outcomes.
* Facilitate requirements-gathering sessions, stakeholder interviews, and solution design workshops.
* Translate business needs into functional requirements, user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria, and workflow diagrams.
* Identify opportunities to improve existing processes through dashboards, data visualization, workflow automation, and low-code applications.
* Develop wireframes, mockups, and conceptual dashboards to communicate proposed solutions.
* Maintain requirements traceability throughout development, testing, and deployment.

**Project Management & Solution Delivery**

* Lead and coordinate small to medium-sized technology initiatives from requirements definition through deployment and customer acceptance.
* Develop project plans, milestones, schedules, deliverables, and status reports.
* Coordinate with application developers, data engineers, and other technical resources to ensure solutions meet customer requirements.
* Manage product backlogs, prioritize requirements, and facilitate Agile activities as appropriate.
* Identify and manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and changes in scope.
* Facilitate solution demonstrations, stakeholder reviews, user acceptance testing (UAT), and implementation activities.
* Communicate project progress and technical challenges to government stakeholders in clear business terms.

**Data Analytics & Visualization**

* Work with stakeholders to identify key performance indicators (KPIs), operational metrics, reporting needs, and dashboard requirements.
* Support the design and implementation of interactive dashboards and reporting solutions using Microsoft Power BI and related technologies.
* Collaborate with technical teams to identify data sources, data relationships, business rules, and integration requirements.
* Help define dashboard functionality, including filters, drill-down capabilities, interactive visualizations, and geographic/map-based reporting where applicable.
* Assist with validating data accuracy, reporting logic, usability, and the alignment of analytical outputs with mission objectives.

**Microsoft Power Platform & Process Automation**

* Support the development and implementation of business solutions using Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint.
* Evaluate business processes to identify opportunities for low-code applications and workflow automation.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications for Power Apps and related Microsoft 365 solutions.
* Collaborate with developers on application functionality, data integration, access controls, and user experience.
* Participate in solution testing, troubleshooting, user training, and adoption activities.
* Help ensure solutions are maintainable, appropriately documented, and aligned with customer requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* **5+ years of experience** in business analysis, technical project management, business systems analysis, or a related role.
* Experience supporting the delivery of data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or data visualization solutions.
* Demonstrated experience gathering business requirements and translating them into technical specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Power BI and its application to dashboards, reporting, and business decision support.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate, and SharePoint, including an understanding of how these technologies support business applications and process automation.
* Experience coordinating with software developers, analysts, and technical teams to deliver customer-facing solutions.
* Experience with Agile delivery methodologies and project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Strong communication, presentation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently, organize competing priorities, and manage deliverables in a customer-facing environment.
* Ability to work onsite at Fort Belvoir/Alexandria, VA, at least two days per week.

Pay: From $70,000.00 per year

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Security clearance:

* Secret (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Fort Belvoir, VA 22060

**Job Title:** IT Project Manager

**Job Location:** 100% remote

**Employment Period:** Immediate hire for full time work for the period from immediate - September 2031

**Education:**

* At least seven (7) years of project management experience with IT systems and a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or other related scientific or technical field, or
* At least ten (10) years of project management experience with IT systems and no degree requirement

  

**Expected Travel:** None

**Summary Description:**  
OmniSolve is seeking a diverse and multi-talented IT agile project manager to lead a team for a civilian government client. This candidate will be responsible for the lead management of deployments of complex information technology projects and to solve problems that may have wide impact, requiring high levels of functional integration and involving multiple disciplines. The ideal candidate should have prior hands-on IT technical experience, a good understanding of the IT systems development lifecycle; understanding of agile principles and methodologies, including Scrum, Kanban, and traditional project management methods; application security; data integration; and change management. The candidate should possess excellent leadership, customer relationship, and communication skills. This position will be responsible for day-to-day oversight of multiple IT projects and direct interaction with client project managers and leadership.

Founded in 2001, OmniSolve is a leading IT and business process services firm committed to helping clients grow and succeed. We have the broad resources, expertise, stability and dedicated professionals needed to achieve results for our clients. This is a great opportunity to join a winning team. OmniSolve offers a competitive compensation package with opportunities for growth and professional development.

Come grow with us. Learn more at www.omnisolve.com.

Responsibilities include

* End to end management of IT application development from concept to closing, including initiating, planning, requirements gathering, executing, monitoring, controlling, pricing, design, implementation, testing, and deployment
* Manage all aspects of project and program engagement from scope & planning, to vendor management, budget estimation, and security compliance
* Lead initiatives/projects using Agile methodologies in a DevOps framework
* Excellent communication skills; effectively communicate with cross functional teams and multiple lines of business & stakeholders; anticipate
* Track and control outcomes to resolve issues, dependencies and critical path deliverables
* Quarterly Program Management Review presentations to Leadership and various stakeholders
* Ensure adherence to quality standards and best practices; review project deliverables to measure effectiveness including those related to application security and data integration
* Thrive in a fast-paced environment, can wear multiple hats, and be able to juggle competing priorities
* Ability to self-direct, prioritize & deliver with constantly shifting & evolving projects
* Evaluate, assess & analyze metrics and project effectiveness
* Recommend and take action to direct the analysis and solution of problems; revise, as appropriate, to meet changing needs and requirements

The candidate must have experience in the following:

* Demonstrated cross-functional project management experience
* Knowledge of information technology applications, processes, software and equipment
* Knowledge of IT project management principles and software development lifecycle using Agile (e.g. SCRUM or Kanban) and traditional methodologies
* Understanding of data integration communication protocols such as APIs, ETLs, web services, etc.
* Knowledge and experience with systems security requirements and implementation including ability to perform quality assurance of security documents related to procedures, design, implementation, and deployment/operational guides
* Experience working with quality management approaches and techniques; experience working with delivery assurance policies, procedures, and to ensure compliance
* Experience working with techniques and approaches related to the architecture, development, integration, and deployment of project phases
* Demonstrated team performance skills, service mindset approach, and the ability to act as a trusted advisor
* Keen problem solving and critical thinking skills

The following qualifications are preferred but not required,

* Experience with migrating applications to the Cloud
* Experience managing vendors
* PMP and/or CSM certification
* Knowledge of the FedRAMP
* Working experience with SAFe
* Experience using Jira and Confluence or similar tools
* Federal government experience
* Knowledge of Google Suite
* Use of Earned Value Management, Capability Maturity Model Integration (CMMI), Information Technology Information Library (ITIL), and MS Project
