jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
#### **SUMMARY**

ESI is seeking a qualified Senior Business Analyst to assess, develop, enhance, and implement technology solutions that support County agencies. The position will focus primarily on the analysis, improvement, and implementation of Public Safety systems and associated business processes.

The Senior Business Analyst will serve as a key liaison among customer stakeholders, subject matter experts, technical teams, project managers, application developers, and vendors. This individual will validate and refine existing business requirements, evaluate solution options, support vendor implementation activities, and help ensure successful deployment and post-production support of the new system. 2

#### **DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

Business Analysis and Requirements Management Conduct detailed analysis of customer systems, operations, procedures, business processes, and data flows.

Validate, refine, document, consolidate, and communicate business requirements obtained from County stakeholders and subject matter experts.

Translate client and stakeholder requirements into detailed, highly specified system design documentation.

Develop functional and non-functional system requirements using approved business requirements.

Assess business opportunities, define operational and technical problems, and identify viable business and technology solutions.

Analyze existing processes and data flows to support system designs, delivery roadmaps, and integrations. Solution Design, Development, and Integration

Lead or support the high-level design and integration of software development initiatives.

Partner effectively with business users, project managers, application developers, development staff, and vendors throughout the solution lifecycle.

Work with development teams and/or vendors to create prototype designs for medium- to large-risk projects.

Support full lifecycle development activities, including internal and external integration design, testing, troubleshooting, and implementation.

Evaluate the feasibility and suitability of proposed information technology projects and recommend appropriate solutions.

Testing, Implementation, and Operational Support. Create detailed unit and system test scripts based on functional requirements.

Facilitate user acceptance testing activities and coordinate issue resolution as required.

Support vendor activities and County implementation efforts for the Jail Management System replacement.

Gather and document business requirements for change requests, including break/fix activities. reporting, system performance, and process-control metrics.

Serve as a primary technical resource in a post-production environment and contribute to continuous system and process improvement. 5

Stakeholder Engagement and Customer Support. Confer with customer agencies to provide advice, consultation, and technical assistance during project implementation.

Provide responsive, high-quality customer service to internal and external stakeholders.

Establish and maintain productive working relationships with County personnel, vendors, and technical teams.

Participate in or conduct user training as needed. Identify and pursue innovative initiatives that improve current processes, systems, and service delivery.

#### **QUALIFICATIONS**

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Business, Computer Science, or a related field.

At least five years of experience in systems analysis, change management analysis, project management, program analysis, or a closely related discipline.

Demonstrated experience supporting public safety implementations.

Demonstrated experience serving as a primary technical resource in a post-production environment.

#### **About Educology Solutions**

Employees first. Customer always. Mission driven. Everyone matters. Join the vibrant team at ESI where we prioritize our employees’ well-being and champion customer satisfaction above all else. Our culture is defined by a mission-driven approach, ensuring that every member contributes to our collective success. At ESI, we value the unique perspectives each individual brings to the table. Through collaboration and innovation, we’re reshaping the digital landscape of public sector services. If you’re passionate about making a difference, eager to grow professionally, and thrive in a supportive environment, join us in our journey to create impactful solutions and drive positive change.

jobs.description:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

**Department Summary:**

MITRE Mission Computing is a new organization that bridges the gap between Mission and Technology and helps enable MITRE projects to focus on their work, without worrying about compliance and the underlying platform infrastructure. We apply new technologies that can address the Government's most challenging Systems Engineering problems. This is an opportunity for experienced program managers who are highly motivated, innovative, and proactive in their work to enable the rest of MITRE and Sponsors.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the Program Manager for the Federal AI Sandbox program, leading planning, execution, stakeholder coordination, operational oversight, and reporting to ensure successful delivery of program objectives.
* Manage acquisition-related activities across the full lifecycle, including requirements definition, planning, coordination, schedule management, risk management, implementation oversight, and transition to operations for High Performance Computing capabilities.

* Develop and maintain integrated program schedules, milestone tracking, action item logs, risk registers, and status reporting.
* Prepare executive-level briefings, sponsor communications, and decision support materials for leadership and external stakeholders.
* Coordinate across internal and external stakeholders to ensure technical, operational, and programmatic dependencies are understood and managed.
* Monitor program performance, identify risks and issues early, and drive mitigation plans to maintain cost, schedule, and mission objectives.
* Support financial planning, resource coordination, and prioritization across multiple related workstreams.

* Demonstrated experience managing complex technical programs or large-scale technology initiatives.

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Networking Operational Excellence
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to join the AWS Networking Operational Excellence team.  
  
The ideal candidate will require proven technical project management, critical thinking and problem solving skills. The candidate should be open to new challenges, extremely good at multi-tasking, innovative, self-directed and a great team player.
  
  
Candidates should drive continuous process improvement, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional operational and software engineering teams to solve problems and implement new solutions.  
  
You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards deliverables for network operations. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
If you like to work with new technologies and optimize existing technology, and have experience participating in network/systems support for a large-scale enterprise or a service provider, we encourage you to apply! Your work will play a key role in driving the stability and sustainability of next-generation networking solutions.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* You’ll drive both network hardware and software programs to meet the ever-growing customer demand.
* You’ll manage competing cross-organizational projects/programs on a global scale.
* You’ll interact cross-team Network Managers, cross-team Technical Program Managers, Engineers, and Data Center Technicians and senior management.
* You will run meetings, create and maintain timelines, and keep large, diverse groups informed of progress and obstacles.

jobs.description:
The Business Analyst is responsible for leading discovery, facilitation, and requirements development for both technical and non-technical initiatives across the organization. This role partners with stakeholders across departments and business units to identify problems, analyze complex needs, and translate them into clear, actionable requirements that support effective solutions.

The Business Analyst serves as a trusted facilitator and thought partner, supporting alignment and informed decision-making among diverse stakeholder groups. This position requires an experienced analyst who can operate independently, navigate ambiguity, and apply proven business analysis practices. This role helps define the problem space rather than simply documenting proposed solutions and brings clarity in situations where requirements are incomplete, conflicting, or evolving.

**Note: This position is considered Hybrid and will need to commute to ACOG's office located in Washington, D.C.**

#### **Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities but does serve as a coach and mentor for other positions in the department.

#### **Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Lead discovery sessions and stakeholder discussions to define business problems, desired outcomes, success measures, requirements, and assumptions.
* Analyze and document current and future-state processes, workflows, business rules, and system interactions; identify opportunities to reduce complexity, duplication, and manual work.
* Review incoming requests, clarify the business need and impact, identify affected owners and teams, prepare intake summaries, and route requests for evaluation and prioritization. Identify recurring themes and intake bottlenecks to support broader improvements.
* Develop clear, concise, and testable requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for technical and non-technical initiatives, tailoring the analysis approach to the needs and complexity of the work.
* Identify risks, gaps, and dependencies across projects, business processes, applications, digital platforms, data, integrations, vendors, and support teams; engage appropriate subject-matter experts and delivery partners.
* Participate in solution design, backlog refinement, and sprint planning to clarify requirements and maintain alignment on decisions, dependencies, and expected outcomes.

* Perform other duties as assigned to support organizational priorities and strategic initiatives.

#### **Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Advanced business analysis skills, including requirements elicitation, analysis, documentation, and validation.
* Exceptional facilitation skills with the ability to lead productive discussions among diverse, cross-functional stakeholder groups.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to decompose complex problems and synthesize information across teams and departments.
* Ability to gather and organize information about business impact, urgency, risk, dependencies, and expected value to support intake and prioritization decisions.
* Ability to recognize when a request may involve applications, integrations, data, security, infrastructure, digital platforms, or vendor dependencies and engage the appropriate subject-matter experts.
* Proficiency in writing high-quality user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts clearly and concisely.
* Ability to operate independently, manage ambiguity, and drive outcomes without close supervision.

#### **Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree required in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of professional experience performing business analysis in complex organizational environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading requirements and facilitation efforts for cross-functional, multi-department initiatives.
* Proven track record of delivering high-quality requirements and user stories that support successful solution delivery.
* Experience working within Agile delivery frameworks, including Scrum, and supporting analysis practices such as intake process, requirements triage, backlog refinement and user story development.
* Experience using tools such as Wrike, Jira, Azure DevOps, Lucidchart, Miro, Visio, or similar platforms for intake, requirements management, backlog support and process modeling.
* Experience working on both technology-focused and business-focused projects.
* Experience within membership associations or similar organizations is helpful but not required.
* Strong understanding of organizational operations, change impacts, and stakeholder management.

This role is instrumental in strengthening the quality, consistency, and accessibility of the firm’s data to support investment operations and decision-making. Current priorities include a firm-wide data governance program, day-to-day analysis of firm data using SQL in Snowflake, ongoing maintenance and enhancement of the firm’s Salesforce platform, and the implementation of new software and system integrations as projects arise. The position involves close collaboration with business users, internal teams, and external vendors to ensure successful execution and adoption of these solutions. This role is best suited to a self-motivated professional who takes ownership of problems from first report through resolution, digs into the details others might overlook, and moves work forward without waiting to be asked. Success in this role also requires clear communication and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

**Responsibilities**

* Support the implementation of new software platforms and integrations as projects arise, from requirements gathering through configuration review, testing, and user adoption.
* Translate and supplement user requirements for outside vendors and internal developers. This includes breaking down requests and providing supporting calculations and examples.
* Write and refine SQL queries in Snowflake daily to analyze, profile, and validate data across systems and ensure data integrity and reliable reporting.
* Build and maintain queries, reports, and dashboards in tools such as Hex to make data accessible to business users.
* Document implementation decisions, data flows, dependencies, and risks.
* Verify that requirements are met at every stage of a project through hands-on testing and coordination of User Acceptance Testing.
* Keep projects on schedule, communicate updates and blockers proactively, and manage scope expectations with internal stakeholders and vendors.

**The opportunity**

Join easyJet’s Cyber Threat Intelligence team and help identify, assess and communicate threats that matter most to our customers and business. With a particular focus on fraud, digital risk and brand protection, you’ll help provide the intelligence that supports informed decisions and proactive defence.

Working across CTEM and alongside teams including Fraud, Loyalty, Brand and the SOC, you’ll contribute to investigations, monitoring activity and intelligence reporting that helps reduce risk across the airline.

You’ll be part of a collaborative Cyber Threat Intelligence function focused on helping easyJet stay ahead of a rapidly changing threat landscape. The team values curiosity, continuous learning and practical intelligence that delivers real outcomes.

You’ll monitor cyber threats, fraud trends, impersonation activity, account takeover risks and wider digital abuse affecting easyJet customers and brand. You’ll help triage, investigate and escalate emerging threats when action is needed.

To start, we're partnering with the world's biggest built world institutions from $T alternative assets investors, prolific developers and even governments to push the frontier of what's possible. We're backed by c-suite from Blackstone and OpenAI alongside the world's best venture capital firms.

Join us in shaping the future of the Built World and exponentially accelerate your career in the process. We welcome you to do your life's work here.

**About the role**
------------------

Build validates powered land and built world opportunities faster than anyone else - power capacity, energisation dates, zoning, title, pricing. The quality of every one of those answers depends on knowing the market better than the market knows itself.

This role owns Build's market intelligence. You'll track where capacity is coming online, what land and assets are trading for, who is building what and where, and turn that into research our clients, our domain experts and our AI workflows use every day. You'll work closely with our geospatial and data engineering team to decide what data we need, find it, and make sure it's right.

**What you will own**
---------------------

* Market coverage: data center, power, industrial and institutional real estate markets across the US and Europe - supply, demand, pipeline, pricing and transactions
* Research outputs: market reports, site and submarket briefs, and client-ready analysis that supports live deals
* Source discovery: finding and evaluating new public, proprietary and alternative data sources, and working with engineering to bring them into Build's platform
* Data quality: checking that the numbers behind every site and market view are accurate, current and defensible
* Insight into product: turning recurring research questions into workflows and checks that our AI can run at scale

**Who this might be**
---------------------

* An analyst or researcher on a data center, energy or capital markets research team at a brokerage, investor or advisory firm
* Someone from a real estate or infrastructure data company who knows where the good data lives and where it breaks
* A strategy or due diligence analyst who has screened markets and sites across multiple geographies
* Strong with spreadsheets and data tools; SQL or Python is a strong plus

**How to win at Build**
-----------------------

Growing Build requires a radically different approach to company building. As a company we're focused on one outcome: winning. That means we move fast, work with intensity, and demand excellence from ourselves. We operate with intensity but create an environment that allows for a lot of fun together. The result is that we're one of the fastest shipping teams in vertical AI, partnering with the best to automate the world around us.

Performance and teamwork are the core of Build's operation. We look for those who are able to do both, who often exhibit a particular ability for;

Velocity: You are relentless in asking the right questions to set direction. Once you find the right direction you go all-in.

Excellence: You obsess with being the best. For you, excellence is a non-negotiable standard rather than an aspiration.

Long time horizons: You choose to be in something for the long run, because that's where most of the returns are realized.

Ownership: You take full ownership of the outcomes. You're meticulous in your pursuits and believe you can actively shape your environment rather than adapt to it.

Customers: You have a passion for the built world and those who shape it. You probably have a quirky hobby or story that relates to your love for building.

Integrity: You chose to do the right thing even when it isn't easy.

Trust: You only work with people you can trust because it's the only way to do truly extraordinary things.

Yield: You have a burning need to see a result on every action you take and you're always looking for routes to do more with less.

**What we offer**
-----------------

Radical autonomy, real ownership: High standards. Minimal bureaucracy. You own problems end-to-end, choose how the work gets done, and are accountable for exceptional outcomes. Ownership is matched with meaningful, generous equity.

An accelerated founder's track: Build is for builders. If you want to learn what it actually takes to create a generational company - Product judgment, execution speed, and accountability - there is no faster path than building from zero when everything is for grabs.

Elite teammates, uncompromising bar: You work with people who think clearly, execute relentlessly, and take full ownership. The team you build becomes the company you build. Growth here is not just professional; it reshapes how you operate and in return how Build operates.

Perpetual adventure: We attract the strongest of the strange. Extraordinary experiences are part of the culture - from the food we eat together to the space we occupy. Intensity is intentional.

Shape the built world: We are rebuilding how the physical world gets made. Our software doesn't live in the abstract - it turns into real projects breaking ground because we exist. We work with the largest institutions, push the frontier of AI, and watch our decisions translate di

jobs.title: Payroll Data Analyst
jobs.description:
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data, solving problems and finding smarter ways of working. You'll use your analytical expertise to identify trends, improve processes and provide valuable insights that support payroll accuracy, compliance and improvements by working collaboratively with colleagues across Payroll, People, Finance and Operations.

  
  

**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

* **Turning data into insights:** Analysing payroll information to identify trends, anomalies and opportunities for improvement, providing meaningful insights to support business decisions.
* **Ensuring accuracy:** Performing payroll reconciliations, validating data and investigating discrepancies to maintain accurate and reliable payroll information.
* **Delivering effective reporting:** Creating and maintaining payroll reports, dashboards and key performance indicators, including analysis of payroll costs, overtime, absence, pensions and statutory payments.
* **Strengthening compliance:** Supporting payroll audits, data quality checks and internal controls, ensuring compliance with HMRC requirements, National Minimum Wage legislation and data protection regulations.
* **Driving improvements:** Identifying opportunities to simplify processes, automate reporting and improve how we manage payroll data.
* **Supporting systems and projects:** Contributing to payroll system enhancements, testing, implementations and data migration activities.
* **Working collaboratively:** Partnering with Payroll, People, Reward, People Systems and Finance colleagues, translating complex data into clear, actionable information.
  

  

**What you'll bring:**

* Experience in payroll reporting, finance analysis or data analytics, ideally within a complex organisation.
* Confidence working with large datasets, producing detailed reports and investigating discrepancies.
* Advanced Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, Power Query, complex formulas and data validation.
* Experience working with payroll systems and HR databases.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear, practical recommendations.
* A high level of accuracy and attention to detail, particularly when working with sensitive payroll information.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships with stakeholders across the business.
* The ability to manage competing priorities and deliver accurate work to deadlines.
* Strong knowledge of National Minimum Wage legislation and compliance, including salary sacrifice, deductions, working time calculations and payroll checks.

**It would also be great if you have:**

* Experience using Workday or OpenPeople payroll systems.
* Knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, SQL or other data reporting and extraction tools.
* An understanding of UK payroll legislation, including PAYE, National Insurance, pensions and statutory payments.
* Experience supporting payroll system implementations, upgrades or testing projects.
  

  

**Why Join Medivet?**
---------------------

At Medivet, we're passionate about creating an environment where our people can thrive and make a meaningful contribution.

Joining our team means becoming part of a collaborative business where your expertise and ideas are valued. You'll have the opportunity to work with colleagues across different functions, contribute to meaningful improvements and help shape how we use data to support our people and our practices.

If you're analytical, curious and motivated by making things work better, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Principal Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Indra is a leading global technology and consulting company, and a trusted technological partner for the core business operations of its clients worldwide. It stands at the forefront of key sectors including Transport, Defence, Air Traffic Management and Space, alongside advanced Information Technology services delivered through Minsait, and cutting-edge capabilities in Sovereign AI, Cybersecurity, and Cyberdefence via IndraMind.

The company's business model is built around a comprehensive portfolio of proprietary products, combining strong innovation with a high-value focus for customers.

With more than 2,500 projects implemented across 50 countries and over 100 cities, Indra is a global benchmark in innovative transportation and mobility solutions. It is recognised as one of the world's top three companies in public transportation management systems. Indra's technology supports the daily journeys of over 78 million people, helping to reduce more than 10 million tonnes of CO₂ emissions annually, and helping save nearly 3,000 lives through improved traffic management and road safety.

Indra Group is paving the way to a more secure and better-connected future through innovative solutions, trusted relationships and the very best talent. Sustainability sits at the heart of its strategy and culture, driving efforts to address current and future social and environmental challenges.

In the 2024 financial year, Indra achieved revenues of €5.5 billion, over 60,000 professionals, maintained a local presence in 46 countries, and operated across more than 140 countries worldwide.

As the technological partner for its customers' key operations, Indra is at the core of their business, and Indra's four values guide everything we do:

**Innovation** - Our capacity for innovation, cutting-edge solutions, and specialised team of professionals enables us to drive a safer, more connected future through technology.

**Trust** - We work with strength, commitment, and reliability, delivering quality solutions to build trust with customers, employees, partners, investors, and society.

**Connection** - We harness the power of collaboration, connect ideas and solutions, and adapt to our customers' needs, supporting them on the path to a better future.

**Foresight** - We anticipate future needs to make the world safer and more connected, transforming our experience and knowledge into solutions for a better tomorrow.

**Overview****Role Purpose:**

* Lead the discovery, requirements definition, target operating model design and business case development for a standardised, ITIL-aligned Asset Management capability.
* Connect hardware and software asset management, lifecycle management, spares and logistics, security, finance, contracts, data and tooling into a coherent managed service capability.

**Key Objectives**

What the Role Will Achieve:

* Establish an evidence-based view of current processes, tools, data, reporting, ownership and customer obligations.
* Define end-to-end requirements from plan and procure through operate, replace, retire and dispose.
* Align stakeholders on the target operating model, governance, service boundaries and accountabilities.
* Create a prioritised, traceable requirements catalogue and an investable business case.
* Define the tooling, integration, pilot and rollout direction.

Core Scope:

* Hardware and Software Asset Management.
* Lifecycle, end-of-life and end-of-support governance.
* Spares, depots, logistics, asset movement and chain of custody.
* Contract, licence, security, audit and financial governance.
* ServiceNow, discovery, repositories, barcode, warehouse and licence tooling.

Key Responsibilities

Analysis and Engagement Leadership

* Own the BA approach, plan, standards, scope and requirements governance.
* Lead workshops across Managed Services, Field Services, Contracts, Finance, Procurement, Security, Service Design and Tooling.
* Resolve conflicting needs and escalate material decisions, risks and dependencies.
* Provide direction and quality assurance to the supporting BA.

Design and Business Case

* Lead current-state, gap, pain-point, risk and duplication analysis.
* Develop the operating model, process architecture, governance, RACI, service catalogue and reporting framework.
* Assess tooling and integration options against agreed requirements.
* Develop costs, benefits, risks, funding profile, phasing, pilot scope and roadmap.

Key Deliverables

* Current-state assessment and process maps.
* Requirements catalogue and traceability.
* Target operating model.
* Governance and RACI.
* Future-state process architecture.
* Service catalogue and customer reporting framework.
* Tooling and integration assessment.
* Business case.
* Pilot definition.
* Implementation roadmap.

 **Requirements**  
  
Essential

* Extensive experience leading complex BA or enterprise transformation engagements.
* Strong requirements engineering, process modelling, facilitation and operating model design skills.
* Ability to work across operational, commercial, financial, security, data and technology stakeholders.
* Experience shaping business cases and leading other analysts.
* Excellent executive communication, negotiation and decision facilitation.

Desirable

* ITIL, IT service management or managed services experience.
* Hardware, Software or IT Asset Management experience.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow, CMDB, discovery or licence management tooling.
* Understanding of lifecycle, spares, logistics, audit, compliance and secure disposal.
* Experience in complex customer and supplier environments.

jobs.title: Creative Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Creative Project ManagerOverview:  
The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting-edge services that help our customers grow. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, this team provides consulting, marketing, loyalty and analytics to financial institutions and merchants globally. Marketing Services is the team within Services that develops and executes the marketing programs that help our clients achieve their marketing goals. The Advisors Creative Desk sits within Services and is responsible for ideating and creating engaging, forward-thinking, on-brand content solutions that connect our advertising partners, platforms, and our portfolio of brands.
  
  
As Creative Project Manager you must have a passion for business growth and ensuring the seamless delivery of projects to clients. You will have a creative flair, relish working in a fast-paced environment and be able to manage multiple project deliverables. You will have solid stakeholder management and communication skills and a clear understanding of the end-to-end process of project delivery. To excel in this role, you need to possess superior communication and interpersonal skills, as well as the ability to tackle several creative projects simultaneously. Working knowledge of project management tools, along with superior organizational skills are a must in this position. You are also expected to possess excellent time-management skills to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment.  
  
  
  
Role:  
Own the day-to-day management of creative projects from brief to delivery, ensuring timelines, scope, and quality standards are met.
  
Track and manage project budgets, timelines, and resourcing plans, escalating issues proactively to senior leads.
  
Lead client communication on project-level matters, responding to requests and maintaining clarity on deliverables and timelines.
  
Develop and manage creative project briefs, translating client needs into clear direction for creative teams.
  
Coordinate across creative, strategy, and production teams to drive delivery and maintain momentum.
  
Work closely with creative leads and senior project managers to stay aligned on priorities.
  
Monitor project progress, manage dependencies, and flag risks early to keep work on track.
  
Run multiple projects in parallel, operating confidently in a fast-paced agency environment.
  
Prepare and deliver regular project status updates and reporting for internal stakeholders and clients.
  
Champion strong organizational practices and effective use of project management tools across the team.  
  
  
  
  
All About You:  
Minimum 8 years of experience in creative services, account, or project management roles, ideally at Account director level, within advertising or creative agencies.
  
Proven ability to manage complex projects end-to-end, with strong organizational and multitasking skills.
  
Experience working with multidisciplinary teams across creative, strategy, and production.
  
Confident in briefing creative teams and maintaining clear project direction from kick-off through delivery.
  
Comfortable managing client relationships at a day-to-day level with professionalism and clarity.
  
Able to work independently, problem-solve on the fly, and perform well under pressure.
  
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  
Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
  
Willingness to travel as required.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Arada | Senior Project Manager - Development
jobs.description:
**About us**

At Arada, we create communities that inspire healthier, happier and more meaningful lives. Through innovative developments, exceptional customer experiences and a commitment to sustainability, we are shaping places where people can live, work and thrive.

Joining Arada means becoming part of a collaborative, ambitious and forward-thinking team dedicated to delivering excellence across every aspect of our business.

**Role Purpose:**

The Senior Project Manager will lead the end-to-end execution of development projects from design development through procurement, construction, handover, and close-out. Working closely with internal stakeholders, consultants, contractors, and authorities, the successful candidate will ensure the successful delivery of projects aligned with ARADA's strategic objectives, quality expectations, and commercial goals.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Project Leadership

* Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and successful delivery of assigned development projects.
* Manage projects through all development phases including design, authority approvals, procurement, construction, testing & commissioning, handover, and defects liability period.
* Develop and maintain detailed project execution plans, schedules, budgets, and risk registers.
* Monitor project performance against agreed milestones and implement corrective actions where required.

Design & Development Management

* Coordinate with the Design Management team to ensure designs meet project objectives, regulatory requirements, cost targets, and construction feasibility.
* Review consultant deliverables to ensure quality, completeness, and alignment with project briefs.
* Drive value engineering initiatives while maintaining design intent and customer experience.

Construction Management

* Oversee contractors, consultants, and project management consultants throughout project execution.
* Monitor construction progress, quality, health & safety, and compliance with project specifications.
* Conduct regular site inspections and progress meetings to ensure timely issue resolution.
* Ensure projects achieve practical completion and handover in accordance with company standards.

Commercial & Financial Management

* Work closely with Commercial and Procurement teams to monitor project budgets and cost performance.
* Review variation orders, claims, payment applications, and commercial risks.
* Support contract administration and ensure contractual obligations are fulfilled.

Stakeholder Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders across Development, Design, Commercial, Finance, Legal, Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Facilities Management.
* Coordinate with government authorities and utility providers to obtain required approvals and permits.
* Build strong relationships with consultants, contractors, and external partners.

Risk & Governance

* Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Ensure compliance with company governance, development processes, quality standards, and HSE requirements.
* Prepare executive reports and project updates for senior management.

Continuous Improvement

* Drive lessons learned initiatives and implement best practices across projects.
* Promote innovation, sustainability, and efficient project delivery methodologies.
* Mentor and support junior project managers and engineers where required.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* Master's Degree or professional certifications (PMP, RICS, CIOB, PRINCE2) would be an advantage.

**Experience**

* Minimum **10–15 years** of experience in real estate development or project management.
* At least **5 years managing large-scale mixed-use, residential, hospitality, retail, or commercial developments in the UAE.**
* Previous experience working with a master developer or leading real estate developer is highly preferred.
* Strong understanding of the UAE development lifecycle, authority approvals, procurement, construction, and handover processes.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of project management methodologies and construction practices.
* Experience managing consultants, contractors, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Excellent understanding of FIDIC contracts and contract administration.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, Excel, and project reporting tools.
* Strong commercial awareness and financial management capabilities.
* Familiarity with UAE authority approval processes and local regulations.

**Core Competencies**

* Leadership and team management
* Strategic thinking
* Stakeholder management
* Project planning and execution
* Commercial acumen
* Negotiation and influencing skills
* Decision-making under pressure
* Risk management
* Quality and customer focus
* Excellent communication and presentation skills

**Using GenAI in Your Application Process**

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.

**Why join Arada?**

At Arada, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to projects that transform communities while working alongside talented professionals in a culture that values innovation, collaboration and continuous growth. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive and make a meaningful impact.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Arada is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals and make employment decisions based on merit, experience and business needs.

jobs.title: Program Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Date Posted:**

**Country:**

United States of America

**Location:**

US-CA-EL SEGUNDO-E01 ~ 2000 E El Segundo Blvd ~ BLDG E01

**Position Role Type:**

Onsite

**U.S. Citizen, U.S. Person, or Immigration Status Requirements:**

The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

**Security Clearance Type:**

DoD Clearance: Secret

**Security Clearance Status:**

Active and existing security clearance required after day 1

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

  

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The Raytheon Operations & Supply Chain (OSC) organization within the Radio Frequency Solutions (RFS) Sub-Strategic Business Unit (SSBU) is looking for a Program Operations Manager (POM) in support of the Surveillance and Tactical Radar Solutions (STaRS) portfolio. This position will partner with a cross-functional program team and the applicable manufacturing sites (factories) to develop and execute a manufacturing strategy that supports business objectives and drives cost, schedule, and technical performance

This position is an onsite role in El Segundo, CA

**What You Will Do**

* Partner with program and business leadership to shape, develop and execute the strategies and objectives of the product line to achieve the cost, quality and schedule goals
* Drive front end of the business activities including capital strategy & execution and manufacturing strategy (make/buy/where)
* Work with program and factory teams to establish accurate Bill of Material (BOM) and executable build plan
* Establish an executable manufacturing plan and manage operations specific risks and opportunities
* Coordinate & develop operations requirements for all gate reviews & execute proposed strategies from early gate reviews for effective implementation in future production
* Lead and collaborate with cross functional teams to drive cost, schedule, technical performance
* Own program On Time Delivery and development of recovery strategies as required
* Interface daily with factory and program management to communicate operations status, issues/help needed, risks and opportunities
* Collaborate cross-functionally across multiple internal functional within RTX to track TAT (Turnaround Time) and repair inductions
* Prepare & present information for Monthly Management Reviews, summarizing program status & any on-going production issues
* Maintain collaborative and responsive relationships within the product line and with functional support organizations
* Manage operations proposal activities including Basis of Estimate (BOE) generation and ensure costs & challenges are understood by operations/factory leadership
* Obtain Program Management Certification (PML5) within 12 months of hire
* Obtain Earned Value Certification or equivalent within 6 months of hire

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in Operations, Manufacturing, Engineering and/or Program / Project Management
* Experience with manufacturing / shop floor execution
* Experience with Risk & Opportunity management, Estimate at Complete (EAC), Control Account Manager (CAM) and/or Earned Value (EV).
* Typically requires: A University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum 8 years prior relevant experience, or An Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 5 years experience

jobs.title: Global Intelligence Manager
jobs.description:
The Global Intelligence Manager leads the Protective Intelligence mission within the Global Intelligence & Threat Analysis (GITA) team, serving as the enterprise lead for Protective Intelligence across The Walt Disney Company and affiliated business units. As a senior individual contributor, this role identifies emerging threats, assesses evolving risks, and produces finished intelligence supporting the protection of executives, talent, employees, productions, major events, executive travel, and other designated individuals.

Serving as the primary intelligence partner to Protective Services, the Protective Intelligence Manager transforms information from diverse internal, external, commercial, government, law enforcement, and open-source reporting into timely, analytically rigorous intelligence that enables proactive, risk-informed protective security decisions. The role also leads GITA's North America intelligence mission by continuously assessing the regional threat environment and evaluating developments involving targeted violence, grievance-driven actors, extremism, organized crime, geopolitical events, technology-enabled threats, and other issues that could affect Company personnel, operations, or reputation.

**Your Role on the Team**

As the Global Intelligence Manager, you are accountable for GITA's Protective Intelligence capability. You establish intelligence priorities, define intelligence requirements, guide collection and analytical efforts, and ensure intelligence products meet the highest standards of objectivity, quality, and operational relevance. You are responsible for ensuring GITA answers the organization's highest-priority protective intelligence requirements by identifying emerging threats, assessing evolving risks, and providing intelligence that informs protective planning, operational decision-making, and enterprise risk management.

**Every Day Is Different — Depending on the Day, You Will…**

* Lead GITA's Protective Intelligence capability, ensuring intelligence priorities align with evolving enterprise risks and Protective Services requirements.
* Operate with a high degree of autonomy, exercising sound judgment, ownership, and accountability while independently managing competing priorities and delivering intelligence products with minimal oversight.
* Develop and manage intelligence requirements and collection plans supporting executive protection, executive travel, major events, and other protective security missions.
* Identify, assess, and analyze threats affecting executives, talent, productions, major events, facilities, and other designated individuals.
* Produce Executive Intelligence Assessments, Major Event Risk Assessments, Executive Travel Risk Assessments, other finished intelligence supporting security decision-making.
* Continuously assess the North America threat environment, identifying changes in adversary capability, intent, or targeting and evaluating developments involving targeted violence, extremism, organized crime, civil unrest, geopolitical events, technology-enabled threats, and other emerging risks.
* Integrate intelligence from open-source, commercial, government, law enforcement, and internal sources to develop objective, comprehensive intelligence assessments.
* Brief senior Global Security leaders and operational partners on emerging threats, intelligence assessments, and strategic risk considerations to influence how executives understand and react to global events that could significantly impact the business.
* Build and maintain trusted partnerships across Protective Services, GSCC, GSI, Entertainment Security, business units, law enforcement, and external intelligence partners to ensure intelligence informs protective planning and operational decision-making.
* Partner with Global Security stakeholders to define data requirements and ensure information captured across shared enterprise platforms is structured and leveraged to support trend analysis, pattern identification, and the production of finished intelligence.
* Continuously improve GITA's Protective Intelligence capability by identifying opportunities to enhance intelligence collection, analytical methodologies, tradecraft, technology, and intelligence products.

**What You Will Need to Be Successful**

* +7 years of progressively responsible experience in protective intelligence, intelligence analysis, threat assessment, corporate intelligence, national security, military intelligence, or law enforcement intelligence.
* Demonstrated experience leading an intelligence mission, capability, or analytical portfolio, including establishing intelligence requirements, guiding collection priorities, and producing finished intelligence that informs executive decision-making.
* Demonstrated expertise producing finished intelligence, executive-level assessments, and strategic intelligence products supporting protective security, executive protection, or intelligence operations.
* Exceptional analytical judgment with the ability to synthesize complex information into concise, objective, and actionable intelligence for senior executives and operational leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex intelligence portfolios, exercise sound judgment in ambiguous environments, and consistently deliver high-quality work with minimal oversight.
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional partners, establish trusted stakeholder relationships, and provide technical leadership without formal supervisory authority.
* Excellent executive-level written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Eligibility for or possession of a U.S. Government-sponsored security clearance (SECRET or higher).

**Education is important to us, here is what we are looking for…**

* Bachelor’s degree in Intelligence Studies, Security Studies, International Relations, Political Science, Criminal Justice, or a related field.

**It Would Be a Plus If You Have…**

* Master's degree in Intelligence

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - EV Charging Platform OCPP & NET Core
jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE:**

We are an end-to-end Renewable Energy provider. We offer products to commercial and enterprise clients in EV Charging solutions, Fleet Electrification, Solar Micro-grids, Energy storage, Hydroponic farming and Rain Water/Grey Water collection systems. We have been experiencing tremendous growth in all these areas and operate under several government rebate programs that ensure a steady and reliable flow of revenues. Our company handles the entire flow of providing these products and services beginning with Sales, Provisioning, Design and Engineering, Contracting and Construction, Servicing and Maintenance. If you are passionate about the EV industry and working with awesome teams in a fast-growing company, we want to speak with you! Join us in making a meaningful impact!

**JOB SUMMARY**

You will own the delivery of our cloud Charging Station Management System (CSMS): a .NET Core platform that keeps thousands of DC fast chargers and Level 2 stations online, billing correctly, and compliant with OCPP 1.6J and 2.0.1. The chargers are hardware from multiple manufacturers running firmware we do not control; the platform must talk to all of them reliably, at scale, over long-lived WebSocket connections.  
  
This is a hands-on technical program role, not a project-coordination role. You will read OCPP message logs, sit in on architecture reviews, decide when a firmware vendor's deviation from spec gets a workaround versus a pushback, and translate utility, regulator and customer requirements into engineering milestones the team can commit to. You are the single point of accountability for whether the platform roadmap ships on time and interoperates in the field.

You will work across backend engineering, firmware and hardware partners, QA and certification, field operations, and commercial teams, and act as the primary technical interface to charger manufacturers, charge point operators (CPOs), e-mobility service providers (eMSPs) and enterprise fleet customers.

  

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

**Program strategy and roadmap**

Own the CSMS technical roadmap: define program scope, phase gates, success criteria and release cadence, and keep it aligned with commercial commitments and regulatory deadlines.  

Translate business, customer and regulatory requirements into epics, acceptance criteria and milestones engineering can estimate and commit to.  
Run quarterly planning, weekly program reviews and release go/no-go decisions; publish status, risks and decisions to leadership in a form non-engineers can act on.  
Prioritize across competing demands (new charger onboarding, customer integrations, protocol upgrades, platform reliability) with explicit trade-offs, not a growing backlog.  

**OCPP implementation and interoperability**

Oversee implementation and conformance of OCPP 1.6J and 2.0.1 across all supported profiles: Core, Firmware Management, Local Auth List, Reservation, Smart Charging, Remote Trigger, and 2.0.1 functional blocks including Provisioning, Authorization, Transactions, Tariff & Cost, Diagnostics and Security.  

Own the charger onboarding program: define the certification matrix per manufacturer/firmware version, run interoperability test plans, and sign off before a model is approved for field deployment.  
Maintain the known-deviations register: where a vendor's firmware departs from spec, decide between a platform-side workaround, a vendor fix, or declining support, and document the decision.  
Lead the OCPP 1.6J to 2.0.1 migration plan for the installed base, including dual-protocol operation, security profile upgrades (TLS, client certificates), and firmware rollout sequencing.  
Coordinate participation in OCA plugfests and third-party conformance testing; track OCPP 2.1 and ISO 15118-20 readiness.  

**Architecture and engineering partnership**

Partner with .NET Core architects on an event-driven microservices design that handles tens of thousands of concurrent WebSocket sessions, high-frequency MeterValues ingestion, and exactly-once transaction handling.  

Set and enforce non-functional requirements: connection stability, message latency, offline transaction recovery, horizontal scalability, observability and multi-region failover.  
Review technical designs for protocol correctness, backward compatibility and operational risk before implementation starts.  
Ensure the platform exposes clean, versioned APIs for customer portals, mobile apps, fleet management systems, payment processors and OCPI partners.  

**Risk, dependency and quality management**

Identify and mitigate hardware-to-cloud compatibility risks, firmware update bottlenecks, certificate expiry, and cross-team dependencies before they affect field uptime.  

Own the incident review loop for protocol-related outages: root cause, corrective action, and roadmap change if the failure is structural.  
Define release quality bars: automated OCPP conformance tests, load tests against charger simulators, and staged rollouts with rollback criteria.  
Track and report platform KPIs: charger uptime, session success rate, transaction reconciliation accuracy, mean time to onboard a new charger model, and firmware campaign completion rate.  

**Stakeholder, vendor and customer management**

Act as the primary technical interface for charger manufacturers, firmware vendors, utilities, CPOs, eMSPs and enterprise fleet customers.  

Negotiate technical scope, timelines and acceptance criteria with vendors; hold them to delivery and escalate with evidence when they slip.  
Lead customer-facing technical onboarding for large deployments: integration design, cutover plans, pilot acceptance and hypercare.  
Drive hardware certification and compliance workstreams (UL/ETL listing, Energy Star, NEVI/CFI program requirements, utility make-ready and demand-response integrations) in coordination with hardware and compliance teams.  

**Security and compliance**

Own the OCPP 2.0.1 security program: security

jobs.description:
**Description de l'entreprise**

Leader de l’Ingénierie et des IT Services, présent dans plus de 30 pays, le groupe ALTEN accompagne la stratégie de développement de ses clients dans les domaines de l’innovation, de la R&D et des systèmes d'information technologiques.

Plus qu’un poste, découvrez l’aventure qui vous attend au sein d’une entreprise engagée.

 **Description du poste**

Le Business Analyst Supply Chain accompagne les projets de transformation sur les activités Ventes, Distribution et Supply Chain opérationnelle.

Le poste offre une large exposition aux processus métier, à l'analyse de données et aux programmes internationaux, et constitue une base solide pour évoluer vers des fonctions en Supply Chain, gestion de projet ou transformation.

**Missions principales :**

**1. Analyse métier et compréhension des processus**

* Contribuer à l'analyse des processus Supply Chain et distribution de bout en bout.
* Documenter les pratiques métier actuelles et cibles.
* Recueillir et structurer les besoins auprès des différentes parties prenantes.
* Analyser les difficultés opérationnelles, les irritants et les opportunités d'amélioration.
* Préparer des recommandations pour faciliter la prise de décision.

**2. Transformation Ventes et Distribution**

* Contribuer aux initiatives d'amélioration de l'efficacité des processus de vente et de distribution.
* Accompagner la convergence des pratiques entre régions et organisations.
* Identifier les écarts de processus et les bonnes pratiques.
* Participer aux travaux liés à la gestion des commandes, à la distribution, à la logistique et à la livraison client.
* Suivre l'avancement des objectifs et des plans d'action de transformation.

**3. Analyse de données et suivi de la performance**

* Collecter, consolider et analyser les données opérationnelles et métier.
* Préparer des tableaux de bord, rapports et présentations pour le management.
* Contribuer à la définition d'indicateurs de performance.
* Traduire les données en recommandations concrètes.
* Suivre la performance et les résultats de la transformation.

**4. Collaboration transverse**

* Participer à des ateliers avec les métiers, les opérations, les régions et les équipes IT.
* Faciliter le partage d'information entre les parties prenantes.
* Contribuer à la coordination entre équipes métier et équipes projet.
* Contribuer à construire l'alignement autour d'objectifs et de priorités communs.
* Documenter les décisions, actions et résultats clés.

**5. Support projet et transformation**

* Contribuer à la planification, au suivi et au reporting du projet.
* Réaliser des présentations PowerPoint de qualité et des synthèses.
* Contribuer à la documentation projet et aux supports de gouvernance.
* Suivre les actions, dépendances et risques liés à la transformation.
* Assurer la traçabilité des décisions clés et des livrables.

  
**Qualifications**

**Qualifications :**

**Savoir être :**

* Esprit analytique.
* Curiosité et envie d'apprendre dans des environnements métier complexes.
* Approche structurée et organisée.
* Bonnes qualités de communication et aisance relationnelle.
* Capacité à travailler dans un environnement international et multiculturel.
* Capacité à synthétiser des informations complexes en messages clairs.

**Compétences :**

* Capacités d'analyse métier et de résolution de problèmes.
* Bonne maîtrise de PowerPoint et d'Excel.

* La connaissance de la Supply Chain, des ventes, de la distribution ou de la logistique est un plus.

* Power BI, la data visualisation ou le process mining sont un plus.
* Anglais : B2 minimum.

**Formation et expérience :**

* Bac+5 en commerce, management, Supply Chain, ingénierie ou domaine équivalent.

jobs.title: Immigration Program Manager (Operations)
jobs.description:
SummaryMeta is seeking an operations manager within its immigration program to lead the operating model for complex Talent Acquisition programs and the processes recruiting runs on. This person decides where the function should invest its process and program effort, sets the standards that recruiting teams work to, and carries the judgment calls on compliance risk, standardization, and sequencing. They will work from hiring priorities rather than defined project briefs, and they are accountable for outcomes across a stakeholder set they do not manage.The role also carries functional ownership of Meta's PERM recruitment process: a specialized, compliance-critical domain where this person is the company's internal authority on process and operations. We are looking for an experienced TA program and process owner who can hold that compliance line. Deep PERM expertise is valuable but can be built with support from the Immigration team and outside counsel.  
  
  

### **Immigration Program Manager (Operations) Responsibilities:**

* Portfolio and Operating Model Ownership
* Define, plan and execute complex TA programs and cross-functional initiatives. Identify which problems are worth solving, make the case for them, and sequence them against hiring priorities and capacity
* Set the operating model for how TA programs are scoped, governed, launched, and transitioned to steady state, and hold teams to it
* Own the relationship with outside counsel on PERM matters, setting the agenda on program-level strategy and taking a position on individual case strategy rather than relaying it
* Define the roles, responsibilities, and controls within the PERM recruitment process, then build the processes that drive sustained adherence across TA, Hiring Managers, and TA Operations
* Set the direction for the PERM Recruitment Enhancement initiative, including scope, risk appetite, and the standard the redesigned process must meet
* Serve as function manager for Meta's Talent Center PERM recruitment process, owning process health, compliance posture, and outcomes
* PERM Recruitment Program Ownership
* Initiate permanent residence cases with outside counsel and manage case progression against filing timelines
* Own the documentation standard for PERM (immigrant visa) filings, and ensure the process remains audit-ready by design rather than by remediation
* Act as the internal authority and escalation point for the Immigration team, foreign national employees, and HR partners on PERM questions
* Translate ambiguous or competing hiring priorities into a multi-quarter roadmap, and make the trade-off calls when priorities conflict
* Own the measures of success for the portfolio, including clearly defined success criteria and performance benchmarks
* Build mechanisms that let programs run without you: clear ownership, documentation, performance measures, and review cadence
* Process Architecture and Operational Excellence
* Own the end-to-end design of priority TA processes: workforce demand intake, requisition launch, sourcing, screening, interviewing, selection, offer management, preboarding, and recruiting operations
* Decide where processes should be standardized in ways that improve speed, quality, consistency and compliance and be able to defend those decisions to stakeholders
* Diagnose root causes behind systemic process failure rather than individual bottlenecks, and distinguish problems worth fixing from noise
* Set decision rights, handoffs, service expectations, escalation paths, and operating mechanisms across recruiting teams, including where those boundaries sit with Finance, Legal, and IT
* Establish the playbooks, SOPs, and governance practices that become the reference standard for recruiting execution
* Define the requirements that recruiting technology and ATS workflows must meet, and hold systems partners to them
* Build the data and feedback mechanisms that make continuous improvement a property of the function rather than a project activity
* Influence and Stakeholder Leadership
* Advise TA and business leaders on process and program strategy, including when their stated ask is not the right one
* Drive accountability across recruiters, coordinators, sourcers, hiring managers, interviewers, systems teams, Finance, Legal, and IT without direct authority
* Resolve contested design decisions across concurrent workstreams, and escalate with a recommendation rather than a question
* Raise the capability of other program and operations practitioners through mentoring, review, and reusable standards

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Track record of owning a program or process domain end to end as the accountable individual
* Experience setting direction in ambiguity: defining the problem, building the case for investment, and sequencing work against competing priorities
* Experience designing operational processes that were adopted beyond the team that built them, with measurable improvement
* Change management experience at a scale where adoption, not delivery, was the hard part
* Experience advising and influencing senior leaders, including redirecting a stated ask
* Experience owning the requirements and standards that recruiting technology and ATS workflows are held to, and using operational data to drive decisions
* Experience owning a compliance posture in a regulated or audit-exposed environment, including the judgment on where risk is acceptable
* Ability to make complex requirements legible to non-expert audiences and to senior decision makers

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Working knowledge of how PERM recruitment obligations interact with non-discrimination and IER requirements
* Direct PERM labor certification experience, including recruitment requirements, prevailing wage determinations, audit response, and documentation standards
* Experience with PERM or immigration compliance at a large, high-volume employer
* Experience managing outside counsel or major

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Frontier Security and Privacy, DeepMind
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in technical/engineering program management.
* Experience developing/launching products/technologies within security, privacy, or a related area.
  

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience that intersects with security and artificial intelligence.
* Significant experience partnering with and influencing executive stakeholders across functions and organizations to navigate conflicting priorities, and drive aligned interpretations and outcomes.
* Experience in managing sizable security and privacy programs in a fast-moving and evolving environment, with proven skill to navigate through ambiguity and adjust and adapt program strategies as conditions change.

**About the job**
-----------------

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Partner with engineering and product leads to manage high-complexity technical challenges, translating ambiguous requirements into structured roadmaps and driving end-to-end execution.
* Drive consensus with VP and Director-level leadership as well as cross-Google partners, steering critical security and privacy outcomes and navigating organizational change in high-velocity settings.
* Develop deep technical knowledge across DeepMind's advanced models, core infrastructure, and product ecosystems to lead frontier security and privacy initiatives and deliver effective technical solutions.
* Help, define and steer organizational security and privacy strategy, maintaining operational agility and alignment across shifting, fast-moving priorities.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.description:
**A World-Changing Company**

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

**The Role**

This is an exciting role responsible for the development, management, and execution of physical security outcomes, supporting our thriving US business delivering protection at facilities and events. You will be responsible for leading physical security and compliance within a diverse set of physical security and safety requirements. You will protect our people, facilities, and assets. This role is highly autonomous. You will have the opportunity to develop, maintain, and report on a first-class physical security capability while responsible for protecting some of our most critical data.

Your operational security expertise should be second only to your integrity and real passion for physical security, people, and mission impact. Our ideal candidate is a self-starter, highly collaborative, and highly motivated. You can operate independently and enjoy solving problems and tackling new challenges. You must have a strong security attitude, care deeply about Physical Security and Safety, and be motivated to protect our people and facilities against all threats.

### **In this role, you will work closely with Palantir's internal development teams and implementation teams to:**

* Act as the primary point of contact for physical security between the employees, internal security teams, and internal Palantir operational teams
* Design, plan, and implement a broad range of controls to safeguard people and customer data in highly sensitive environments.
* Directly lead, manage and mentor physical security personnel, maintaining clear performance standards while developing future physical security leaders

### **Core Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain a physical security program that effectively meets compliance and security requirements as stated in our customer contract. Perform technical implementation of various controls, processes, and procedures.
* Interface directly with internal operations, security teams, and security vendors to support business and security objectives, e.g. a safe and secure working environment, with consistent, high-quality customer service to employees, customers, and visitors. Independently own projects with balancing competing priorities
* Manage incident response to physical events, ensuring employee and asset safety while minimizing operational impact
* Advise our operations teams and employees on physical security, policy, processes, and trends
* Provide physical security domain expertise on protective controls, to include contract personnel, fire and safety, CCTV/access control

### **What We Value**

* Ability to effectively communicate complex physical security concepts to diverse audiences, both verbally and in writing
* Experience working in high-security and/or technology industry environments with significant security, compliance, and governance requirements
* Exposure to various physical security fields, with deep familiarity and conceptual understanding in one or more areas of specialization (e.g., Incident Response/Investigation, Guard Force/Vendor Management, CCTV/Access Control, Workplace Safety, Event Security/Executive Protection)
* Comprehensive knowledge of modern adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures, and the motivation to creatively thwart them

### **What We Require**

* 5+ years of experience in a physical security role leading physical security programs
* A degree in a relevant field (Risk Management, Physical Security, Emergency Management) or an equivalent accredited certification (PSP preferred)
* Eligibility and willingness to obtain a US Security Clearance
* Ability to travel up to 25% of the time

**Salary**

The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $70,000 - $100,000/year. Total compensation for this position may also include Restricted Stock units, sign-on bonus and other potential future incentives. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual's relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.
