jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Pinterest:**

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we're on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other's unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It's Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we're looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we'll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

**Staff Technical Program Manager, Advanced Technology Group**

Pinterest Technical Program Managers deliver critical and strategic outcomes by directing and scaling engineering effort across organizational and functional boundaries.

Pinterest is looking for a highly technical, experienced Staff TPM to join the Advanced Technology Group (ATG), a research-driven engineering organization advancing Pinterest's ML/AI capabilities. You'll partner directly with senior product and engineering leaders to turn ambitious AI strategy into shipped, reliable, and widely adopted capabilities. This is a high-visibility role spanning research, ML platform, infrastructure, safety, and product teams.

  

**What you'll do:**

* Lead complex, multi-workstream programs across ML research, platform engineering, infrastructure, safety/compliance, and product, aligned under one roadmap, metrics, and governance.
* Partner closely with the VPs of Product and Engineering to translate strategy into workstreams, staffing, milestones, and clear decision-making.
* Drive the path from research to production: model development, evaluation, release management, serving capacity, and adoption by product teams.
* Define and track metrics and guardrails (quality, cost, reliability, adoption, cycle time) and use them to drive decisions.
* Run technical design and decision forums; identify risks and tradeoffs early and align senior leaders on a path forward.
* Build operating mechanisms (planning, reviews, intake, launch readiness, post-mortems) that scale across teams working at different paces.
* Use AI tooling to automate tracking, reporting, and program insights.
* Communicate status, risks, and decisions to executives and cross-functional partners, tailoring technical depth to the audience.

  

**What we're looking for:**

* Minimum 8 years in technical program management, engineering, or related roles, with a track record of leading org-level, multi-team ML/AI or platform programs.
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* Deep technical understanding of ML/AI systems (training and post-training, evaluation, model serving, GPU capacity, release management) and platform engineering. You can read design docs and challenge assumptions.
* Experience with LLM/multimodal model adoption, such as adapting open-source models, evaluation frameworks, and migrating workloads between model providers, is a strong plus.
* Proven ability to partner with VP and Director-level leaders in Product and Engineering and influence strategy and prioritization.
* Experience designing planning processes and governance (annual and multi-half planning) across several organizations.
* Strong analytical skills: SQL, dashboards, and using data from experiments and evaluations to drive decisions.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
When you care deeply about the work you do, it’s rewarding to see it through from concept to completion. We partner with clients to provide both program management and construction management to strategize, plan, and implement projects that drive organizations forward. From hospitals and airports to university campuses, mass transit systems, water treatment facilities, mines, and wind farms, we've successfully managed thousands of projects.

Joining our team, turning visionary ideas into reality, will shape your future—and the future of your community.

We are strategizing, planning, and implementing projects that help clients achieve their organization’s objectives. Join our award-winning program management team and bring transformational project solutions to life.

Your Opportunity

As a Program Manager in Stantec you will lead a team and ensure adherence to the mission and objectives of the assigned program. You will have leadership responsibility for an integrated program team composed of both client and consultant staff. Duties of the Program Manager include client coordination, providing day-to-day guidance to multi-disciplined teams in a co-located Program Management Office (PMO) environment, typically located at a client facility. You will assist owners/clients with execution of the program, addressing strategy and delivery challenges and supporting internal client departments as may be required. You will oversee implementation of program delivery procedures and processes and confirm the program team’s performance against stated objectives.

The Program Manager oversees all services provided by an integrated team, including but not limited to: general program and project management services (scheduling, cost controls, risk management, change management, document control, interface management, engineering management etc.), preliminary design, subject matter expert technical support on projects, regulatory and permitting support, technical studies to support planning and design efforts, procurement of design and construction, construction management, operations & maintenance liaison, operations and maintenance readiness, community outreach and communications, project and program delivery strategy, funding strategy and training/knowledge transfer.

The Program Manager is responsible to track and manage delivery performance (cost, schedule, quality) on each project and the overall program.

Your Key Responsibilities

* Advising and assisting the client in the development, management, and execution of the program.
* Leading and overseeing the work of a multi-disciplinary client, consultant, and sub-consultant team.
* Serving as a trusted advisor to the client and working as part of an integrated Client/Consultant Leadership Team.
* Overseeing the effective mobilization and set-up of the program in conjunction with the Stantec Mobilization Manager.
* Implementation of a robust governance structure to ensure adherence to a rigorous approach to project and program management.
* Implementation of program methodologies for project evaluation and selection of appropriate delivery models.
* Establishment of a performance reporting framework including the development of key performance indicators and associated reports/dashboards.
* Pro-actively identifying client needs and programmatic initiatives required to address potential program delivery risks and challenges.
* Assisting the client in development of its staff through implementation of best practices, training classes and knowledge transfer.
* Developing, negotiating, and managing consultant services authorizations for program management services.
* Overseeing administration of the management consultant services contract including management of change orders, amendments, task order renewals, and invoicing working with Stantec Finance and Accounting support staff.
* Compliance with all Stantec internal processes and procedures including preparation of reports and other deliverables as required by internal delivery governance requirements.
* Preparing or overseeing preparation of reports and other deliverables defined in the contract scope of services.
* Management of subconsultants, including negotiating of subcontract agreements, review of invoices, and compliance with any Diverse, Local, and Small Business Enterprise requirements by the client.
* Reviewing consultant and contractor submittals including technical and contractual documents.
* Providing programmatic and technical support related to client governing bodies and various other departments.

Your Capabilities and Credentials

* Must be able to demonstrate strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work in a team environment.
* Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to convey program and project delivery needs to the client and to formulate those needs into comprehensive proposals.
* Must demonstrate organizational skills and ability to work on multiple projects and activities simultaneously.
* The position involves work associated with critical infrastructure; therefore, a client background check is required.
* Strong technical understanding of water and wastewater utility infrastructure, organizations and processes required.
* Knowledgeable in relevant areas of pre-construction and construction including understanding of various design and construction contracting methods and processes.
* Experience supporting sales processes for acquisition of new program opportunities and startup of new capital infrastructure programs is desirable.

Education and Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, or related field required
* 20+ years experience in the delivery of water/wastewater projects/programs.
* 10+ years leading large water/wastewater programs ($1B or higher) with a large construction management element featuring traditional and collaborative delivery methods.
* MS in Engineering or MBA
* PMP / PgMP (PMI)

AppLovin makes technologies that help businesses of every size connect to their ideal customers. The company provides end-to-end advertising solutions for businesses to reach, monetize and grow their global audiences. For more information about AppLovin, visit: www.applovin.com.

To deliver on this mission, our global team is composed of team members with life experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives that mirror our developers and customers around the world. At AppLovin, we are intentional about the team and culture we are building, seeking candidates who are outstanding in their own right and also demonstrate their support of others.

### **About the Role**

We are seeking a smart, hardworking Business Operations Analyst to provide technical and operational support to our Business Operations (BizOps) team and the systems supporting our mobile-advertising business.

A central part of this role is helping other BizOps analysts deliver reliable projects. You will review their code, debug existing workflows, investigate product issues, and translate business problems into actionable requests for Engineering and Operations. You will also write and maintain your own workflow code and analyze product features and experiments.

You will serve as a practical link between business and technical teams. We're looking for someone who learns quickly, investigates problems independently, exercises good judgment, and follows issues through to resolution.

We are looking for a TPO Business Analyst to join our TPO Business Strategy team to serve as the analytical engine connecting product development, operations, and enterprise partner feedback. jobs.title: Operations Analyst, User Safety & Risk Operations
jobs.description:
Trust & Safety - San Francisco

**About the Team**

At OpenAIs of misuse. We translate real-world user and operational signals into timely decisions, practical interventions, and improvements to our products and systems.

This role will take on new, ambiguous, or underdeveloped operational risks and help mature them into scalable capabilities. We work across USRO and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Product Policy, Legal, Safety, Support, and external vendors or partnership stakeholders.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Senior Operations Analyst to take on complex, ambiguous safety and risk problems and turn them into practical operational solutions that can scale. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a versatile operator who is comfortable moving between queues, investigation, analysis, workflow design, hands-on execution, and cross-functional leadership. Depending on team needs, the role may focus on emerging-risk incubation, cloud deployment partnerships, or other new operational areas.

You will be expected to move quickly, work hands-on, and create structure without waiting for perfect requirements or a large support team. The work starts with the problem, not a prescribed process. You may investigate unstructured user signals, stand up a lightweight workflow, build an AI-assisted tool, improve an existing operation, or help a new launch become operationally ready. The goal is to produce durable systems that other people can run, not simply complete a series of individual tasks.

The portfolio will change with company priorities and may span established harm areas, emerging-risk incubation, cloud deployments and partnerships, device safety, or new product launches. Some hires may focus primarily on cloud deployment operations, including launch readiness, partner coordination, safety workflows, and operational monitoring. You will typically own a small number of high-impact problems at a time and will be expected to judge what needs to be built, what can stay lightweight, and when the work is ready to scale, transfer, or stop.

Location / work model: San Francisco, CA; hybrid, 3 days/week in-office.

***Please note:*** *This role may involve exposure to sensitive or concerning content. Strong discretion, good judgment, and resilience are essential.*

**In This Role, You Will**

* Take ownership of ambiguous, high-priority safety and risk problems: define the problem, gather the right evidence, choose a practical path, drive execution, and close the loop.
* Analyze structured and unstructured data, both quantitative and qualitative. This may include user reports, case narratives, conversations, escalations, and operational metrics to identify patterns, risks, and the highest-leverage interventions.
* Build and test lightweight workflows, tools, automations, and decision aids that improve speed, quality, and consistency, then iterate based on real-world use.
* Turn one-off insights and manual work into scalable operating mechanisms without adding unnecessary process or complexity.
* Lead sensitive investigations, incident response, or launch-readiness work, including safety workflows, human review, escalation paths, partner coordination, and operational monitoring for product launches or cloud deployments.
* Work directly with cross-functional and external partners to clarify ownership, resolve operational gaps, and turn incomplete signals into clear recommendations and decisions.
* Measure whether the work is improving outcomes—such as quality, speed, coverage, operator effort, or risk reduction—and adjust quickly when it is not.
* Help junior operators build judgment and independence through coaching, calibration, and reusable tools.

**You Might Thrive in This Role If You**

* Have 8+ years of experience in trust and safety operations, investigations, incident response, product operations, technical program management, or another high-judgment, data-heavy operational field.
* Have a track record as a scrappy generalist who can enter an unfamiliar problem, learn quickly, and deliver with limited structure or support.
* Are highly data savvyation and combine it with quantitative evidence.
* Are technically fluent and hands-on with AI tools, dashboards, and data tooling, and can build or prototype practical solutions without waiting for a dedicated technical team.
* Operate independently, make clear tradeoffs, and maintain momentum as priorities and requirements change.
* Think in systems: you look beyond the immediate task and build approaches that can be repeated, measured, and operated by others.
* Exercise strong judgment in sensitive situations involving user impact, policy, legal risk, technical constraints, and business priorities.
* Communicate clearly and directlyal authority.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in trust and safety, fraud, product safety, integrity, or another adversarial or high-severity risk domain.
* Experience moving a new or immature workflow from early investigation into stable, scaled operations.
* Experience supporting cloud platforms or deployment partnerships, enterprise products, product launches, connected devices, or other technically complex programs. Direct cloud experience is a plus, not a requirement.
* Familiarity with SQL, lightweight scripting, no-code tools, workflow automation, or AI-assisted development.

jobs.title: Security Analyst
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

Solairus Aviation is seeking a Senior Security Analyst to help protect the people, systems, and data behind its business aviation operations. Working as a peer alongside a second Security Analyst, this role shares responsibility for day-to-day security operations, including monitoring, alert triage, incident response, identity and access hygiene, and continuous improvement of the security program. The two analysts divide workload, cover for each other, and rotate after-hours responsibilities so the function runs consistently. This is a full-time, on-site position that works primarily standard business hours with participation in a shared after-hours on-call rotation for security incidents.

  

This position follows a hybrid schedule, with four days per week in the office and one day working from home.

**Essential Responsibilities/Duties**
-------------------------------------

Essential Duties

* Monitor, triage, and investigate security alerts across email, endpoint, identity, and cloud environments, escalating confirmed incidents according to established procedures.

* Participate in incident response, including containment, evidence collection, documentation, and post-incident review.

* Support identity and access management by reviewing access, maintaining role-based group assignments, and enforcing least-privilege and privileged access controls.

* Administer and tune security tooling to reduce noise and improve detection quality.

* Support email security, phishing response, and security awareness training.

* Assist with vulnerability management by tracking remediation of identified risks with IT partners.

* Maintain and improve security operations documentation, including SOPs, runbooks, and reporting metrics.

* Support compliance, audit, and eDiscovery requests as needed.

* Share an on-call rotation with the other Security Analyst and provide mutual coverage during absences.

* Partner with the Help Desk and broader IT team on security-related tickets and user guidance.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* 2–4 years of experience in security operations, IT security, or a related systems administration role with substantial security responsibilities.
* Working knowledge of security information and event management (SIEM), endpoint detection and response (EDR), identity provider/single sign-on (SSO), and email security platforms.
* Understanding of incident response fundamentals, common attack techniques, and log analysis.
* Strong written communication skills, including the ability to clearly document findings for technical teams and leadership.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with a peer.
* Willingness to participate in a shared after-hours on-call rotation for security incidents.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, CrowdStrike Falcon, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Purview, Delinea Secret Server/Privilege Manager, and Mimecast or comparable email security platforms.
* Familiarity with ticketing and incident management tools such as Zendesk and incident.io, as well as remote monitoring and management (RMM) platforms such as NinjaOne.
* Scripting or query experience using KQL, PowerShell, or Python.
* Industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+, Microsoft SC-200, or GIAC GSEC/GCIH.
* Experience in aviation or another regulated environment with 24/7 operations.

Crowned Grace International (CGINTL) is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned and Woman-Owned Small Business that delivers management consulting, workforce transformation, and mission support to the Department of Defense, federal civilian agencies, and Fortune 1000 clients. CGINTL is building a team to help a federal civilian agency's Office of Acquisitions close a backlog of expired contracts, including cost-reimbursement contracts, IDIQs, and fixed-price and time-and-materials awards. You will lead the program end to end: setting the closeout plan and burn-down targets with the Contracting Officers, building and managing the team, removing blockers, and making sure every package that reaches the Government is complete, compliant, and ready for signature.

* **Program leadership and Government liaison:** Acts as the primary point of contact for the COR and Contracting Officers. Leads kickoff, weekly status meetings, and monthly program reviews; documents Government direction and decisions.

* **Staffing and personnel management:** Recruits, onboards, and assigns staff; manages badging and PIV processing; evaluates performance; directs any teammate; adjusts staffing as backlog volumes and CO priorities change.
* **Risk, issue, and escalation management:** Identifies blockers such as missing contractor releases, unsettled indirect rates, unreconciled unliquidated obligations, and non-responsive contractors; escalates each with a recommended course of action.
* **Quality and compliance oversight:** Owns the Quality Control Plan; enforces the inherently governmental boundary, safeguarding of contractor proprietary and personal information, personal conflict-of-interest requirements, and limitations on subcontracting.
* **Contract administration and reporting:** Delivers monthly status reports and contract deliverables, reviews invoices, and manages transition-in and transition-out.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business, public administration, or a related discipline.
* 10 years of directly related experience, including 5 years managing federal acquisition, contract administration, or acquisition-support programs.

* Thorough knowledge of FAR Parts 4 and 42 closeout requirements and the roles of the CO, COR, and contractor
* Ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams to measurable production targets
* Skill in briefing senior Government officials and resolving issues across organizational lines
* Proficiency with project scheduling, metrics, and status reporting tools
* Ability to obtain and maintain a federal background investigation and PIV credential

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree
* FAC-C (Professional) or DoD Contracting Professional certification
* Prior management of a contract closeout or acquisition operations support program

**Work Environment**

Virtual position. May require travel to outreach events and occasional work outside normal hours.

**Our Culture**

At CGINTL, everyone is a Leader. We hire to, develop toward, and hold one another accountable to seven Core Values: IntegrityTrust; Credibility; Accountability ("No Excuses Here"); Continuous Improvement; Action Orientation; Caring for the Team, the Client, and the Business; and Marketplace Ministry.

Core responsibilities include designing workstream operational frameworks, defining and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs), proactively mitigating risks, and driving strategic alignment across Sales, Field, Implementation, and Product teams. The Program Manager facilitates cross-functional execution and directly oversees key launch deliverables to meet organizational goals. Articulate the business case and rationale ("why") behind launch initiatives to leadership, internal teams, and practice-facing audiences. Apply working knowledge of value-based care and ACO models to connect launch work to Aledade's broader business goals.

Define operational guidelines and quality gates for AI-assisted workflows to ensure data accuracy, prevent tracking errors, and uphold long-term maintainability. Develop reusable prompt templates and workflow accelerators to empower the team and unlock capacity for high-impact program management. * **Coaching & Thought Partnership:** Support Implementation team members on program-level challenges and help them connect their work to launch goals. new_jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**Who are we?**

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

**About the role**

Smarsh is looking for a Senior Marketing Analyst to build the data foundation that marketing and go-to-market (GTM) teams run on — and that our AI tools will increasingly depend on. AI assistants and agents can only answer revenue questions reliably when the data model beneath them is clean, governed, and well defined. This role owns that layer for marketing: from source-system connectors and Snowflake, through dbt models and a governed semantic layer, to the dashboards, analysis, and AI-driven insight that leadership uses to make decisions.

You'll set the measurement and data roadmap, not just execute against it. You'll partner with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Sales/Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and IT/Data Architecture, and you'll be a trusted analytical partner to marketing and GTM leadership on planning, pipeline, and growth strategy.

### **How will you contribute?**

**AI-ready data foundation**

* Design and build an AI-ready data foundation for marketing and GTM: governed dbt models and a semantic layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Omni) with consistent metric definitions that both people and AI tools can query.
* Prioritize foundation domains in partnership with RevOps and IT — starting with marketing performance and attribution, and connecting to pipeline, account hierarchy, and customer retention data.
* Build validation and testing frameworks (data tests, reconciliation checks, and accuracy evaluation of AI-generated answers) so AI assistants and agents return answers leadership can trust.
* Partner with Marketing Operations and IT to deploy and improve AI tools (e.g., Claude, BI-native AI agents) that answer recurring marketing and pipeline questions in a self-serve way.

**Data architecture & engineering**

* Own the marketing data architecture end to end: source-system connectors, ingestion into Snowflake, transformation logic, orchestration, and curated data models.
* Build and maintain reliable pipelines (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo, Marketo Measure/Bizible, ABM, Google/LinkedIn/Bing Ads, sales engagement platforms) using ELT and orchestration tooling such as Fivetran and Airflow, with monitoring and documented SLAs.
* Model account hierarchies and lead-to-account matching so marketing engagement rolls up correctly to accounts, buying groups, and opportunities.

**Measurement, attribution & analytics**

* Own the design, governance, and evolution of marketing attribution (W-Shaped, Custom Model, and account-level influence), including documenting assumptions and limitations.
* Lead ABM measurement: account engagement scoring, buying-group coverage, intent-to-pipeline conversion, and target-account progression.
* Go beyond descriptive reporting — apply cohort analysis, funnel velocity, incrementality/test-and-control design, and forecasting to answer "what's working, and what should we do next?"
* Analyze campaign and channel performance (organic search, paid search, paid social/ABM, display, email, events, field) and deliver prioritized recommendations on budget and program mix.

**Strategy, reporting & stakeholder leadership**

* Partner with marketing and GTM leadership on annual planning, pipeline targets and coverage, growth strategy, and operating cadences, bringing the analysis that grounds those decisions.
* Build and own executive-grade dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Omni) reconciled against Salesforce and finance data, and own the analytics behind monthly/quarterly business reviews and QBRs.
* Define and govern a single set of marketing metric definitions (MQL/MQA, SAL, pipeline sourced vs. influenced, CAC, ROI) and drive adoption across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
* Set and maintain the marketing analytics roadmap: prioritize requests, balance ad hoc work against foundational builds, and communicate trade-offs.

**Data quality, governance & enablement**

* Establish data quality standards and automated checks across CRM, marketing automation, and the warehouse; fix root causes rather than patching symptoms.
* Ensure marketing data and AI use align with Smarsh data privacy, security, and governance requirements in partnership with Legal, Security, and IT.
* Mentor analysts and Marketing Operations teammates on SQL, dbt, data modeling, and responsible use of AI in analytics.

### **What will you bring?**

* 5+ years of experience in GTM, marketing, or revenue operations analytics, or business intelligence, ideally in B2B SaaS or technology.
* Advanced SQL and hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse (e.g., BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), including designing data models, not just querying them.
* Hands-on dbt experience building production-grade, tested, documented models.

We're a defense-technology company where precision and compliance drive outcomes. Reporting to our Manager of Revenue Operations, and part of a team led by our Director of Revenue Operations, you'll support forecasting, pipeline reporting, deal desk, sales compensation and Salesforce data quality. The goal is clean data, reliable reporting and fast, accurate answers that help Sales, Finance and leadership make better decisions.  
  
This is a high-visibility role with real room to grow. Your work will power the forecast, dashboards and comp numbers that leadership and the board rely on, and you'll see firsthand how complex commercial and government deals come together. You'll get broad exposure across forecasting, deal desk, sales compensation and Salesforce, direct mentorship, and more ownership as the team scales.  
  
**Note:** Candidates must reside in one of our approved hiring hubs:  

* DC/Maryland/Virginia
* Raleigh/Durham/Chapel Hill, NC
* Denver/Colorado Springs, CO
* Dallas/Fort Worth, TX

**What You'll Do**  

* Keep pipeline data clean and trustworthy. Catch missing fields, stale opportunities and stage errors in Salesforce across commercial, federal, and international business units.
* Build and maintain reporting. Create and own Salesforce reports and dashboards for pipeline, bookings, win rates, sales cycle length, renewals and retention, so Sales, Finance and leadership all work from the same numbers.

**What You Bring**  

* 2–4 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, FP&A or a similar analytical role, ideally at a B2B software company.

Furthermore, this opportunity includes potential eligibility for equity awards and discretionary bonuses, rounding out a comprehensive total rewards offering.

new_jobs.title: Information Systems Security Manager
new_jobs.description:
### **About Us**

AGE Solutions is a premier technology and professional services company, providing in-depth consulting, advanced technology solutions, and essential services throughout the U.S. government, defense, and intelligence sectors. Prioritizing innovation and client-focused solutions, we assist major agencies in addressing intricate issues and ensuring a more secure future.

AGE Solutions is seeking an experienced **Information System Security Manager (ISSM)** to support a program with our DoD customer. The ISSM will provide cybersecurity leadership and oversight for assigned information systems, applications, networks, and mission environments. This role is responsible for supporting Risk Management Framework (RMF) implementation, system authorization activities, continuous monitoring, and compliance with Department of Defense (DoD) cybersecurity requirements.

The successful candidate will work closely with Government stakeholders, system owners, engineers, assessors, and Information System Security Officers (ISSOs) to evaluate cybersecurity risks, maintain authorization readiness, and support secure adoption of emerging technologies.

**Responsibilities Include:**

* Lead cybersecurity governance and risk management activities for assigned information systems, applications, networks, and mission environments.
* Oversee RMF implementation, system authorization activities, and ongoing cybersecurity compliance.
* Manage the development, maintenance, and review of authorization documentation, including System Security Plans (SSPs), Security Assessment Reports (SARs), Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), and supporting artifacts.
* Provide oversight of continuous monitoring (ConMon), vulnerability management, remediation activities, and security control assessments.
* Evaluate cybersecurity risks and recommend mitigation strategies, compensating controls, and corrective actions.
* Coordinate with ISSOs, system owners, engineers, assessors, Authorizing Officials, and Government stakeholders to support authorization and risk acceptance decisions.
* Ensure alignment with DoDI 8510.01, applicable NIST guidance, DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), and customer-directed cybersecurity requirements.
* Support cybersecurity inspections, audits, assessments, and authorization readiness reviews.
* Develop cybersecurity metrics, risk assessments, executive-level reports, and briefings.
* Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and oversight to ISSOs and supporting cybersecurity personnel.
* Assess security implications associated with emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), autonomous systems, cloud environments, and experimental capabilities.
* Recommend risk mitigations, compensating controls, and security safeguards for prototypes, pilot programs, and test environments that may not align with traditional authorization approaches.
* Develop and maintain authorization packages and supporting security documentation for emerging technologies, prototypes, and pilot initiatives.

**Required Skills, Qualifications, and Experience:**

* **Citizenship and Clearance:**
  + U.S. Citizenship is required.
  + Must have and maintain a minimum of an active DoD Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain a DoD Top Secret clearance. A current Top Secret clearance is preferred.
* **Education and Certifications:**
  + Bachelor's degree is required.
  + Must meet applicable qualification requirements and possess at least one current certification recognized for DoD 8140 Work Role 722 – Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM), Intermediate level, such as:
    - CISSP
    - CISM
    - CGRC/CAP
    - SecurityX/CASP+
    - Security+
    - CCSP
    - GSEC
* **Experience:**
  + 5–10 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, information assurance, RMF, risk management, or security compliance.
  + Experience supporting RMF implementation, system authorization activities, and cybersecurity governance.
  + Experience developing, reviewing, or managing authorization packages and supporting security documentation.
* **Skills and Knowledge:**
  + Strong understanding of cybersecurity risk assessment, vulnerability management, security controls, and remediation processes.
  + Knowledge of DoDI 8510.01, NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-37, applicable CNSSI requirements, and DISA STIGs.
  + Strong analytical, leadership, communication, and technical documentation skills.
  + Ability to coordinate with technical teams, Government stakeholders, and cybersecurity leadership.
  + Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic mission environment.
  + Ability to obtain and maintain required customer-specific access and credentials.
* **Location:**
  + Candidates must reside within commuting distance of Fort Meade, MD. This position follows a **hybrid** work schedule, requiring onsite presence at Fort Meade two days per week, with additional onsite support as mission requirements dictate.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Experience supporting DoD, DISA, or other federal Government cybersecurity environments.
* Experience supporting cybersecurity authorization activities for cloud platforms, emerging technologies, prototypes, or pilot programs.
* Experience providing technical oversight or mentorship to cybersecurity personnel.

**Work Environment and Physical Demand:**

* This position primarily supports operations at a Government customer site.
* Standard work schedule is Monday through Friday, with adjustments based on mission requirements.
* Personnel must comply with applicable Government facility access, security, and operational requirements.

The projected salary range for this position is $150,000+ annually. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including years of relevant experience, active security clearance

Support full lifecycle development activities, including internal and external integration design, testing, troubleshooting, and implementation.

Evaluate the feasibility and suitability of proposed information technology projects and recommend appropriate solutions.

Testing, Implementation, and Operational Support. Create detailed unit and system test scripts based on functional requirements.

Facilitate user acceptance testing activities and coordinate issue resolution as required.

Support vendor activities and County implementation efforts for the Jail Management System replacement.

Gather and document business requirements for change requests, including break/fix activities. reporting, system performance, and process-control metrics.

Serve as a primary technical resource in a post-production environment and contribute to continuous system and process improvement. 5

Stakeholder Engagement and Customer Support. Confer with customer agencies to provide advice, consultation, and technical assistance during project implementation.

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Business, Computer Science, or a related field.

At least five years of experience in systems analysis, change management analysis, project management, program analysis, or a closely related discipline.

Demonstrated experience serving as a primary technical resource in a post-production environment.

new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to join the AWS Networking Operational Excellence team.  
  
The ideal candidate will require proven technical project management, critical thinking and problem solving skills. The candidate should be open to new challenges, extremely good at multi-tasking, innovative, self-directed and a great team player.
  
  
Candidates should drive continuous process improvement, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional operational and software engineering teams to solve problems and implement new solutions.  
  
You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards deliverables for network operations. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
If you like to work with new technologies and optimize existing technology, and have experience participating in network/systems support for a large-scale enterprise or a service provider, we encourage you to apply! Your work will play a key role in driving the stability and sustainability of next-generation networking solutions.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* You’ll drive both network hardware and software programs to meet the ever-growing customer demand.
* You’ll manage competing cross-organizational projects/programs on a global scale.
* You’ll interact cross-team Network Managers, cross-team Technical Program Managers, Engineers, and Data Center Technicians and senior management.
* You will run meetings, create and maintain timelines, and keep large, diverse groups informed of progress and obstacles.
* You’ll work with engineers to develop detailed and creative solutions to complex problems, while keeping a watchful-eye on timelines and costs.
* You’ll drive simplification efforts in engineering and project/program management, and architectures to unblock innovation.
* You’ll partner with multiple teams across various locations to ensure priorities are agreed and outcomes are delivered.

  
A day in the life  
Technical Program Managers in the BERE organization have a wide range of responsibilities: we work with internal partners to develop and implement the next gen infrastructures along with the tooling ecosystems to support with these platforms driving efficiency and scalability through the automation of builds, configuration deployment, and the scaling of capacity. As our network is one of the largest in the world, there is no blue print at our scale allowing our engineers to develop solutions to the complex challenges that we face daily. We encourage durable solutions that look around corners while taking into consideration our customer needs from a cost, performance, and reliability perspective. Our team develops tooling that provides the required visibility and control of traffic across the network, while prioritizing the automatic mitigation of events to minimize the impact to our customers during events.  
  
About the team  
Within AWS Networking, the Backbone, Enterprise, and Regional Engineering (BERE) organization is responsible for the design, implementation, and operations of a wide array of networking infrastructure that provide global connectivity between all AWS Regions and edge locations. We provide the massive scale required to support our AWS customers and internal services, via a network that grows by 70% annually. In addition, we have teams that are responsible for the design and operation of our global corporate office and data center network, allowing tens of thousands of Amazonians to perform their daily tasks in support of our customers. We provide software tooling that allows the global AWS footprint to scale via new Region and edge location builds, automated systems that control the flow of traffic across devices, and are building our next generation network controllers to drive improved performance and efficiency across the networks that we operate.

------------------------

* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

----------------------------

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

This role partners with stakeholders across departments and business units to identify problems, analyze complex needs, and translate them into clear, actionable requirements that support effective solutions.

The Business Analyst serves as a trusted facilitator and thought partner, supporting alignment and informed decision-making among diverse stakeholder groups. This position requires an experienced analyst who can operate independently, navigate ambiguity, and apply proven business analysis practices. This role helps define the problem space rather than simply documenting proposed solutions and brings clarity in situations where requirements are incomplete, conflicting, or evolving.

#### **Supervisory Responsibilities:**

**The opportunity**

Join easyJet’s Cyber Threat Intelligence team and help identify, assess and communicate threats that matter most to our customers and business. With a particular focus on fraud, digital risk and brand protection, you’ll help provide the intelligence that supports informed decisions and proactive defence.

Working across CTEM and alongside teams including Fraud, Loyalty, Brand and the SOC, you’ll contribute to investigations, monitoring activity and intelligence reporting that helps reduce risk across the airline.

**“This is a role for someone who enjoys connecting the dots. We’re looking for a curious analyst who can investigate emerging threats, make sense of complex information and tell a clear story that helps colleagues take action before risks become problems.”**

**The team & culture**

You’ll be part of a collaborative Cyber Threat Intelligence function focused on helping easyJet stay ahead of a rapidly changing threat landscape. The team values curiosity, continuous learning and practical intelligence that delivers real outcomes.

**What you’ll be doing**

You’ll monitor cyber threats, fraud trends, impersonation activity, account takeover risks and wider digital abuse affecting easyJet customers and brand. You’ll help triage, investigate and escalate emerging threats when action is needed.

Using intelligence from a range of sources, you’ll support investigations into cyber-enabled fraud and develop clear assessments that help stakeholders understand risk, impact and recommended actions.

You’ll contribute to alerts, briefings, advisories and reports for both technical and non-technical audiences, while helping maintain threat intelligence repositories covering threat actors, tactics and fraud trends.

You’ll also support horizon scanning activities, tracking developments such as AI-enabled fraud, cybercrime services and evolving attack techniques that could affect the business.

An understanding of threats such as phishing, social engineering, scams, impersonation, credential abuse and account takeover will help you succeed. You’ll also be confident communicating with a wide range of stakeholders.

new_jobs.title: Junior Investment Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
At the Pension Protection Fund (PPF), we provide security in retirement for our members and millions of people throughout the UK who belong to defined benefit (DB) pension schemes. Through the PPF and Financial Assistance Scheme (FAS), we compensate members for their pensions after the employer funding their pension becomes insolvent. In total, we look after over 400,000 members across the PPF and FAS. With over £30 billion in assets under management, our investments support long-term economic growth across the UK.

Our award-winning team of around 450 professionals has earned the IPE UK Pension Fund of the Year title three times in seven years. We work closely with government and industry partners to improve outcomes for scheme members, employers, and the broader pension system—playing a vital role in strengthening retirement security nationwide.

We’re looking for a **Junior Investment Operations Analyst** to join our Investment Operations team to contribute to all Fund Accounting aspects of the Investment process of the PPF.

Responsibilities will include the maintenance of trading records and other first line support duties, using BlackRock, Aladdin. Additionally, applicants will support trade processes for internal and external trades, data integrity checking including investigating any differences and monitoring of daily inbox flows to ensure routine checklists are complete.

We’re looking for an individual with experience working within an investment environment and exposure to a range of investment products, such as fixed income, equities and derivatives. Experience of, or exposure to, alternative asset classes would be highly desirable. You’ll have experience in delivering high-quality customer service, including supporting the resolution of queries, issues and change requests, with a consistent focus on accuracy and attention to detail.

We would welcome applications from candidates with advanced data management and numeracy skills, alongside the ability to communicate effectively with a range of stakeholders, including third-party providers. Finally, experience using BlackRock Aladdin would be advantageous.

Sound like you? **Apply now.**

In return for your skills, experience and commitment we’ll give you a challenging role within a business where you’ll get the support you need to develop your career.

We’ll also give you lots of opportunities for personal development and skills training.

*We’re proud to be a* *Disability Confident Leader* *and actively encourage applications from people with disabilities. We are committed to ensuring our recruitment process is inclusive and accessible. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know. We are happy to discuss your needs and ensure you have the support required.*

*We embrace diverse talent welcoming people with different beliefs, backgrounds and ways of working. Whatever your background, and however you identify, you’ll be welcome here.*

**INDMED**

We’re a statutory public corporation led by our board and accountable to Parliament through the Secretary of State for the Department for Work and Pensions. It's our duty to protect people with an eligible defined benefit pension when an employer becomes insolvent.

We’re proud of the work we do. Without us, many people would face significant financial hardship. We’re also proud of our people, all of whom are committed to our mission and to serving over 230,000 members.

new_jobs.description:
**Location**

London, UK

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Location Type**

Remote

**Department**

Customer Success

**Compensation**
----------------

* Estimated Base Salary £67K – £83K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

This range is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills and experience. There may be instances where a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.
  
  
Please note that the compensation details listed on US role postings reflect the base salary only and does not include bonus, equity or benefits.

  

**Company Overview**
====================

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

**Company Operating Rhythm**
============================

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

**Note: this role is based remotely out of London, UK.**
--------------------------------------------------------

**Regional Expectations**
-------------------------

* Based in London with strong overlap to customer business hours.
* Excellent written and spoken English. Additional European languages are a plus.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Deepgram is hiring a **Revenue Operations Analyst** to help build and operate the systems, data, and workflows that power our GTM organization.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes getting into the details: fixing broken workflows, improving data quality, supporting quote-to-cash and usage-based billing processes, and finding ways to automate repetitive work. You’ll work closely with GTM Engineering, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, and Renewals to make our commercial systems more reliable, scalable, and efficient.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Support and improve quote-to-cash workflows, including CPQ, order forms, contract changes, subscriptions, entitlements, and downstream system updates.
* Partner with Finance and GTM Engineering on usage, billing, and monetization workflows, including reconciliation across CRM, product, billing, and finance systems.
* Serve as a hands-on Salesforce and GTM systems operator, building reports, dashboards, flows, automations, and system enhancements.
* Maintain strong data quality and governance across accounts, opportunities, contracts, usage, renewals, and customer records.
* Troubleshoot and resolve GTM systems and process issues, identifying root causes rather than relying on manual workarounds.
* Identify repetitive or high-friction workflows and help build automation and AI-enabled solutions to reduce manual effort.
* Support the systems and reporting used to operationalize forecasting, routing, territory, quota, and commission decisions.
* Partner with the Director, GTM Engineering on system requirements, testing, implementation, documentation, and ongoing optimization.
* Help create scalable operating processes as Deepgram grows, while staying close to the day-to-day work that surfaces where systems need to improve.

**It’s Important to Us That You Have**
--------------------------------------

* 3–4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, Sales Operations, Business Systems, or a related role.
* Strong hands-on Salesforce experience, including reporting, flows, automation, and data management.
* Experience working across CRM, CPQ, billing, contract, or other GTM systems.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
* A track record of improving workflows, not just executing existing processes.
* Comfort using AI and automation tools to reduce manual work and improve operations.
* Ability to work cross-functionally across GTM, Finance, and technical teams.

**It Would Be Great If You Had**
--------------------------------

* Experience in a usage-based or consumption-based business.
* Experience with CPQ and contract-generation tools.
* Familiarity with billing or metering systems.
* SQL or experience working with GTM/customer data.
* Experience with tools such as Claude, Cursor, n8n, Workato, Retool, or similar automation environments.
* Experience in a high-growth SaaS or AI company.

new_jobs.title: CRM & Revenue Operations Analyst

We're looking for a curious, commercially sharp CRM & Revenue Operations Analyst to join our growing RevOps function. This is a dual-natured role: on one side, hands-on CRM administration and data stewardship within a collaborative team; on the other, a broader remit that spans the full commercial journey — from Marketing through Sales to Customer Success — ensuring the processes, tools, and data that connect them are coherent, reliable, and built to support business growth.

You'll work closely with our Revenue Operations Manager, based in Copenhagen, and collaborate with market teams, sales and marketing stakeholders, and internal IT across all 14 markets. – Support the maintenance and ongoing development of our HubSpot CRM in collaboration with the RevOps team — covering data quality, property management, workflow logic, and pipeline integrity across all markets

**Training Materials & Process Documentation**

– 1–2 years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, CRM administration, or a closely adjacent role

– Solid working knowledge of CRM systems — HubSpot experience is a significant advantage and will be strongly prioritised

– Analytically capable, with the ability to turn raw data into clear, usable business insights

– Sharp commercial instinct — you understand how operational decisions connect to revenue outcomes across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success

– Comfortable working cross-functionally, including with technical stakeholders such as IT, and translating between business needs and system capabilities

– Detail-oriented and process-driven, without losing sight of the bigger picture

– Excellent written and spoken English; additional languages are a genuine bonus — Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, German, French, Dutch, Portuguese, or Polish

– Proactively curious — you ask questions before you build, and you build things that last

– Hands-on HubSpot experience beyond basic CRM use — workflows, reporting, custom properties, or integrations

– Familiarity with sales intelligence tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator or Evergrowth

– Experience supporting tool integrations or working alongside IT on system connectivity

– Exposure to multi-market or international business environments

– A track record of creating structured training content or process documentation

– Background in B2B services, IT staffing, or professional consultancy

**What We Offer**

– A central role in emagine's revenue infrastructure, with genuine cross-market scope from day one

– Direct mentorship from an experienced Revenue Operations Manager with deep HubSpot and systems expertise

– Broad exposure to a modern RevOps toolstack and clear room to grow — technically and strategically

– A hybrid working setup with real autonomy and flexibility, based in one of our office locations across our 14 markets

– The opportunity to grow alongside a function that is actively expanding its influence across the business

new_jobs.description:

---------------

AI for the Built World: Build has created the agentic AI stack for institutional real estate, automating complex development and acquisitions workflows 90% faster than humans to accelerate the world's most important built projects - digital infrastructure, energy, industrial - from concept to completion.

Our mission is to accelerate and amplify the world's most important built projects - inventing a better way to build through a collaboration between human experts and agentic AI. This role owns Build's market intelligence. Velocity: You are relentless in asking the right questions to set direction. Once you find the right direction you go all-in.

Excellence: You obsess with being the best. For you, excellence is a non-negotiable standard rather than an aspiration.

Long time horizons: You choose to be in something for the long run, because that's where most of the returns are realized.

Ownership: You take full ownership of the outcomes. You're meticulous in your pursuits and believe you can actively shape your environment rather than adapt to it.

Customers: You have a passion for the built world and those who shape it. You probably have a quirky hobby or story that relates to your love for building.

Integrity: You chose to do the right thing even when it isn't easy.

Trust: You only work with people you can trust because it's the only way to do truly extraordinary things.

Yield: You have a burning need to see a result on every action you take and you're always looking for routes to do more with less.

**What we offer**
-----------------

Radical autonomy, real ownership: High standards. Minimal bureaucracy. You own problems end-to-end, choose how the work gets done, and are accountable for exceptional outcomes. Ownership is matched with meaningful, generous equity.

An accelerated founder's track: Build is for builders. If you want to learn what it actually takes to create a generational company - Product judgment, execution speed, and accountability - there is no faster path than building from zero when everything is for grabs.

Elite teammates, uncompromising bar: You work with people who think clearly, execute relentlessly, and take full ownership. The team you build becomes the company you build. Growth here is not just professional; it reshapes how you operate and in return how Build operates.

new_jobs.title: Payroll Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data, solving problems and finding smarter ways of working. You'll use your analytical expertise to identify trends, improve processes and provide valuable insights that support payroll accuracy, compliance and improvements by working collaboratively with colleagues across Payroll, People, Finance and Operations.

  
  

**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

* **Turning data into insights:** Analysing payroll information to identify trends, anomalies and opportunities for improvement, providing meaningful insights to support business decisions.
* **Ensuring accuracy:** Performing payroll reconciliations, validating data and investigating discrepancies to maintain accurate and reliable payroll information.
* **Delivering effective reporting:** Creating and maintaining payroll reports, dashboards and key performance indicators, including analysis of payroll costs, overtime, absence, pensions and statutory payments.
* **Strengthening compliance:** Supporting payroll audits, data quality checks and internal controls, ensuring compliance with HMRC requirements, National Minimum Wage legislation and data protection regulations.
* **Driving improvements:** Identifying opportunities to simplify processes, automate reporting and improve how we manage payroll data.
* **Supporting systems and projects:** Contributing to payroll system enhancements, testing, implementations and data migration activities.
* **Working collaboratively:** Partnering with Payroll, People, Reward, People Systems and Finance colleagues, translating complex data into clear, actionable information.
  

  

**What you'll bring:**

* Experience in payroll reporting, finance analysis or data analytics, ideally within a complex organisation.
* Confidence working with large datasets, producing detailed reports and investigating discrepancies.
* Advanced Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, Power Query, complex formulas and data validation.
* Experience working with payroll systems and HR databases.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear, practical recommendations.
* A high level of accuracy and attention to detail, particularly when working with sensitive payroll information.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships with stakeholders across the business.
* The ability to manage competing priorities and deliver accurate work to deadlines.
* Strong knowledge of National Minimum Wage legislation and compliance, including salary sacrifice, deductions, working time calculations and payroll checks.

**It would also be great if you have:**

* Experience using Workday or OpenPeople payroll systems.
* Knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, SQL or other data reporting and extraction tools.
* An understanding of UK payroll legislation, including PAYE, National Insurance, pensions and statutory payments.
* Experience supporting payroll system implementations, upgrades or testing projects.
  

  

**Why Join Medivet?**
---------------------

At Medivet, we're passionate about creating an environment where our people can thrive and make a meaningful contribution.

Joining our team means becoming part of a collaborative business where your expertise and ideas are valued. You'll have the opportunity to work with colleagues across different functions, contribute to meaningful improvements and help shape how we use data to support our people and our practices.

If you're analytical, curious and motivated by making things work better, we'd love to hear from you.

new_jobs.title: Principal Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Indra is a leading global technology and consulting company, and a trusted technological partner for the core business operations of its clients worldwide. It stands at the forefront of key sectors including Transport, Defence, Air Traffic Management and Space, alongside advanced Information Technology services delivered through Minsait, and cutting-edge capabilities in Sovereign AI, Cybersecurity, and Cyberdefence via IndraMind.

The company's business model is built around a comprehensive portfolio of proprietary products, combining strong innovation with a high-value focus for customers.

With more than 2,500 projects implemented across 50 countries and over 100 cities, Indra is a global benchmark in innovative transportation and mobility solutions. It is recognised as one of the world's top three companies in public transportation management systems. Indra's technology supports the daily journeys of over 78 million people, helping to reduce more than 10 million tonnes of CO₂ emissions annually, and helping save nearly 3,000 lives through improved traffic management and road safety.

Indra Group is paving the way to a more secure and better-connected future through innovative solutions, trusted relationships and the very best talent. Sustainability sits at the heart of its strategy and culture, driving efforts to address current and future social and environmental challenges.

In the 2024 financial year, Indra achieved revenues of €5.5 billion, over 60,000 professionals, maintained a local presence in 46 countries, and operated across more than 140 countries worldwide.

As the technological partner for its customers' key operations, Indra is at the core of their business, and Indra's four values guide everything we do:

**Innovation** - Our capacity for innovation, cutting-edge solutions, and specialised team of professionals enables us to drive a safer, more connected future through technology.

**Trust** - We work with strength, commitment, and reliability, delivering quality solutions to build trust with customers, employees, partners, investors, and society.

**Connection** - We harness the power of collaboration, connect ideas and solutions, and adapt to our customers' needs, supporting them on the path to a better future.

**Foresight** - We anticipate future needs to make the world safer and more connected, transforming our experience and knowledge into solutions for a better tomorrow.

**Overview****Role Purpose:**

* Lead the discovery, requirements definition, target operating model design and business case development for a standardised, ITIL-aligned Asset Management capability.
* Connect hardware and software asset management, lifecycle management, spares and logistics, security, finance, contracts, data and tooling into a coherent managed service capability.

**Key Objectives**

What the Role Will Achieve:

* Establish an evidence-based view of current processes, tools, data, reporting, ownership and customer obligations.
* Define end-to-end requirements from plan and procure through operate, replace, retire and dispose.
* Align stakeholders on the target operating model, governance, service boundaries and accountabilities.
* Create a prioritised, traceable requirements catalogue and an investable business case.
* Define the tooling, integration, pilot and rollout direction.

Core Scope:

* Hardware and Software Asset Management.
* Lifecycle, end-of-life and end-of-support governance.
* Spares, depots, logistics, asset movement and chain of custody.
* Contract, licence, security, audit and financial governance.
* ServiceNow, discovery, repositories, barcode, warehouse and licence tooling.

Key Responsibilities

Analysis and Engagement Leadership

* Own the BA approach, plan, standards, scope and requirements governance.
* Lead workshops across Managed Services, Field Services, Contracts, Finance, Procurement, Security, Service Design and Tooling.
* Resolve conflicting needs and escalate material decisions, risks and dependencies.
* Provide direction and quality assurance to the supporting BA.

Design and Business Case

* Lead current-state, gap, pain-point, risk and duplication analysis.
* Develop the operating model, process architecture, governance, RACI, service catalogue and reporting framework.
* Assess tooling and integration options against agreed requirements.
* Develop costs, benefits, risks, funding profile, phasing, pilot scope and roadmap.

Key Deliverables

* Current-state assessment and process maps.
* Requirements catalogue and traceability.
* Target operating model.
* Governance and RACI.
* Future-state process architecture.
* Service catalogue and customer reporting framework.
* Tooling and integration assessment.
* Business case.
* Pilot definition.
* Implementation roadmap.

 **Requirements**  
  
Essential

* Extensive experience leading complex BA or enterprise transformation engagements.
* Strong requirements engineering, process modelling, facilitation and operating model design skills.
* Ability to work across operational, commercial, financial, security, data and technology stakeholders.
* Experience shaping business cases and leading other analysts.
* Excellent executive communication, negotiation and decision facilitation.

Desirable

* ITIL, IT service management or managed services experience.
* Hardware, Software or IT Asset Management experience.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow, CMDB, discovery or licence management tooling.
* Understanding of lifecycle, spares, logistics, audit, compliance and secure disposal.
* Experience in complex customer and supplier environments.

new_jobs.description:
The Global Intelligence Manager leads the Protective Intelligence mission within the Global Intelligence & Threat Analysis (GITA) team, serving as the enterprise lead for Protective Intelligence across The Walt Disney Company and affiliated business units. As a senior individual contributor, this role identifies emerging threats, assesses evolving risks, and produces finished intelligence supporting the protection of executives, talent, employees, productions, major events, executive travel, and other designated individuals.

Serving as the primary intelligence partner to Protective Services, the Protective Intelligence Manager transforms information from diverse internal, external, commercial, government, law enforcement, and open-source reporting into timely, analytically rigorous intelligence that enables proactive, risk-informed protective security decisions. The role also leads GITA's North America intelligence mission by continuously assessing the regional threat environment and evaluating developments involving targeted violence, grievance-driven actors, extremism, organized crime, geopolitical events, technology-enabled threats, and other issues that could affect Company personnel, operations, or reputation.

**Your Role on the Team**

As the Global Intelligence Manager, you are accountable for GITA's Protective Intelligence capability. You establish intelligence priorities, define intelligence requirements, guide collection and analytical efforts, and ensure intelligence products meet the highest standards of objectivity, quality, and operational relevance. You are responsible for ensuring GITA answers the organization's highest-priority protective intelligence requirements by identifying emerging threats, assessing evolving risks, and providing intelligence that informs protective planning, operational decision-making, and enterprise risk management.

**Every Day Is Different — Depending on the Day, You Will…**

* Lead GITA's Protective Intelligence capability, ensuring intelligence priorities align with evolving enterprise risks and Protective Services requirements.
* Operate with a high degree of autonomy, exercising sound judgment, ownership, and accountability while independently managing competing priorities and delivering intelligence products with minimal oversight.
* Develop and manage intelligence requirements and collection plans supporting executive protection, executive travel, major events, and other protective security missions.
* Identify, assess, and analyze threats affecting executives, talent, productions, major events, facilities, and other designated individuals.
* Produce Executive Intelligence Assessments, Major Event Risk Assessments, Executive Travel Risk Assessments, other finished intelligence supporting security decision-making.
* Continuously assess the North America threat environment, identifying changes in adversary capability, intent, or targeting and evaluating developments involving targeted violence, extremism, organized crime, civil unrest, geopolitical events, technology-enabled threats, and other emerging risks.
* Integrate intelligence from open-source, commercial, government, law enforcement, and internal sources to develop objective, comprehensive intelligence assessments.
* Brief senior Global Security leaders and operational partners on emerging threats, intelligence assessments, and strategic risk considerations to influence how executives understand and react to global events that could significantly impact the business.
* Build and maintain trusted partnerships across Protective Services, GSCC, GSI, Entertainment Security, business units, law enforcement, and external intelligence partners to ensure intelligence informs protective planning and operational decision-making.
* Partner with Global Security stakeholders to define data requirements and ensure information captured across shared enterprise platforms is structured and leveraged to support trend analysis, pattern identification, and the production of finished intelligence.
* Continuously improve GITA's Protective Intelligence capability by identifying opportunities to enhance intelligence collection, analytical methodologies, tradecraft, technology, and intelligence products.

**What You Will Need to Be Successful**

* +7 years of progressively responsible experience in protective intelligence, intelligence analysis, threat assessment, corporate intelligence, national security, military intelligence, or law enforcement intelligence.
* Demonstrated experience leading an intelligence mission, capability, or analytical portfolio, including establishing intelligence requirements, guiding collection priorities, and producing finished intelligence that informs executive decision-making.
* Demonstrated expertise producing finished intelligence, executive-level assessments, and strategic intelligence products supporting protective security, executive protection, or intelligence operations.
* Exceptional analytical judgment with the ability to synthesize complex information into concise, objective, and actionable intelligence for senior executives and operational leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex intelligence portfolios, exercise sound judgment in ambiguous environments, and consistently deliver high-quality work with minimal oversight.
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional partners, establish trusted stakeholder relationships, and provide technical leadership without formal supervisory authority.
* Excellent executive-level written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Eligibility for or possession of a U.S. Government-sponsored security clearance (SECRET or higher).

**Education is important to us, here is what we are looking for…**

* Bachelor’s degree in Intelligence Studies, Security Studies, International Relations, Political Science, Criminal Justice, or a related field.

**It Would Be a Plus If You Have…**

* Master's degree in Intelligence

**Description de l'entreprise**

Leader de l’Ingénierie et des IT Services, présent dans plus de 30 pays, le groupe ALTEN accompagne la stratégie de développement de ses clients dans les domaines de l’innovation, de la R&D et des systèmes d'information technologiques.

Plus qu’un poste, découvrez l’aventure qui vous attend au sein d’une entreprise engagée.

Le Business Analyst Supply Chain accompagne les projets de transformation sur les activités Ventes, Distribution et Supply Chain opérationnelle.

Le poste offre une large exposition aux processus métier, à l'analyse de données et aux programmes internationaux, et constitue une base solide pour évoluer vers des fonctions en Supply Chain, gestion de projet ou transformation.

**Missions principales :**

**1. Analyse métier et compréhension des processus**

* Analyser les difficultés opérationnelles, les irritants et les opportunités d'amélioration.

**Qualifications**

**Savoir être :**
